The server has received the request head.es: El servidor recibió los encabezados de la solicitud y el cliente puede continuar y enviar el cuerpo.
The server has received the request head.pt-BR: O servidor recebeu os cabeçalhos da requisição e o cliente pode seguir em frente e enviar o corpo.
The server has received the request head.fr: Le serveur a reçu les en-têtes de la requête et le client peut poursuivre en envoyant le corps.
The server has received the request head.de: Der Server hat die Request-Header erhalten, und der Client sollte nun den Body senden.
The server has received the request head.id: Server telah menerima header permintaan dan klien dapat melanjutkan dengan mengirim body.
The server has received the request head.it: Il server ha ricevuto le intestazioni della richiesta e il client può procedere con l'invio del corpo.
The server has received the request head.tr: Sunucu istek başlıklarını aldı ve istemci gövdeyi göndermeye devam etmelidir.
The server has received the request head.vi: Máy chủ đã nhận các header của yêu cầu và máy khách nên tiếp tục gửi phần body.
The server has received the request head.ru: Сервер получил заголовки запроса, и клиенту следует отправлять тело.
The server has received the request head.hi: सर्वर को रिक्वेस्ट हेडर मिल गए हैं और क्लाइंट अब बॉडी भेज सकता है।
The server has received the request head.pl: Serwer odebrał nagłówki żądania, a klient powinien kontynuować i wysłać treść.

Rarely visible: clients such as curl sen.es: Rara vez se ve: clientes como curl envían Expect: 100-continue antes de una subida grande, y el servidor responde con este código antes de la respuesta real.
Rarely visible: clients such as curl sen.pt-BR: Raramente visível: clientes como o curl enviam Expect: 100-continue antes de um upload grande, e o servidor responde com isso antes da resposta de verdade.
Rarely visible: clients such as curl sen.fr: Rarement visible : des clients comme curl envoient Expect: 100-continue avant un gros envoi, et le serveur répond avec ce code avant la vraie réponse.
Rarely visible: clients such as curl sen.de: Selten sichtbar: Clients wie curl senden vor einem großen Upload Expect: 100-continue, und der Server antwortet darauf mit diesem Status, bevor die eigentliche Antwort folgt.
Rarely visible: clients such as curl sen.id: Jarang terlihat: klien seperti curl mengirim Expect: 100-continue sebelum unggahan besar, dan server menjawab dengan kode ini sebelum respons yang sebenarnya.
Rarely visible: clients such as curl sen.it: Raramente visibile: client come curl inviano Expect: 100-continue prima di un upload di grandi dimensioni, e il server risponde con questo codice prima della risposta vera e propria.
Rarely visible: clients such as curl sen.tr: Nadiren görülür: curl gibi istemciler büyük bir yüklemeden önce Expect: 100-continue gönderir ve sunucu gerçek yanıttan önce bununla karşılık verir.
Rarely visible: clients such as curl sen.vi: Hiếm khi thấy: các máy khách như curl gửi Expect: 100-continue trước khi tải lên tệp lớn, và máy chủ trả lời bằng mã này trước phản hồi thực sự.
Rarely visible: clients such as curl sen.ru: Видно редко: клиенты вроде curl отправляют Expect: 100-continue перед большой загрузкой, и сервер отвечает этим кодом до настоящего ответа.
Rarely visible: clients such as curl sen.hi: यह कम ही दिखता है: curl जैसे क्लाइंट बड़े अपलोड से पहले Expect: 100-continue भेजते हैं, और सर्वर असली जवाब से पहले इससे जवाब देता है।
Rarely visible: clients such as curl sen.pl: Rzadko widoczny: klienci tacy jak curl wysyłają Expect: 100-continue przed dużym przesyłaniem, a serwer odpowiada tym kodem przed właściwą odpowiedzią.

Send the request body. If you do not wan.es: Envía el cuerpo de la solicitud. Si no quieres que el servidor lo espere, no envíes el encabezado Expect.
Send the request body. If you do not wan.pt-BR: Envie o corpo da requisição. Se você não quer que o servidor espere por ele, não envie o cabeçalho Expect.
Send the request body. If you do not wan.fr: Envoyez le corps de la requête. Si vous ne voulez pas que le serveur l'attende, n'envoyez pas l'en-tête Expect.
Send the request body. If you do not wan.de: Senden Sie den Request-Body. Wenn der Server nicht darauf warten soll, senden Sie den Expect-Header nicht mit.
Send the request body. If you do not wan.id: Kirim body permintaan. Jika Anda tidak ingin server menunggunya, jangan kirim header Expect.
Send the request body. If you do not wan.it: Invia il corpo della richiesta. Se non vuoi che il server lo aspetti, non inviare l'intestazione Expect.
Send the request body. If you do not wan.tr: İstek gövdesini gönderin. Sunucunun gövdeyi beklemesini istemiyorsanız Expect başlığını göndermeyin.
Send the request body. If you do not wan.vi: Gửi body của yêu cầu. Nếu bạn không muốn máy chủ chờ body, đừng gửi header Expect.
Send the request body. If you do not wan.ru: Отправьте тело запроса. Если не хотите, чтобы сервер его ждал, не отправляйте заголовок Expect.
Send the request body. If you do not wan.hi: रिक्वेस्ट बॉडी भेजें। अगर नहीं चाहते कि सर्वर उसका इंतज़ार करे, तो Expect हेडर न भेजें।
Send the request body. If you do not wan.pl: Wyślij treść żądania. Jeśli nie chcesz, aby serwer na nią czekał, nie wysyłaj nagłówka Expect.

Let your HTTP server or framework handle.es: Deja que tu servidor HTTP o framework lo maneje. Rechaza las subidas grandes lo antes posible con un 4xx final en lugar de leer el cuerpo.
Let your HTTP server or framework handle.pt-BR: Deixe seu servidor HTTP ou framework cuidar disso. Rejeite uploads grandes logo no início com um 4xx final, em vez de ler o corpo.
Let your HTTP server or framework handle.fr: Laissez votre serveur HTTP ou votre framework s'en charger. Rejetez tôt les gros envois avec un 4xx définitif au lieu de lire le corps.
Let your HTTP server or framework handle.de: Überlassen Sie das Ihrem HTTP-Server oder Framework. Weisen Sie große Uploads frühzeitig mit einem finalen 4xx ab, statt den Body einzulesen.
Let your HTTP server or framework handle.id: Serahkan penanganannya kepada server HTTP atau framework Anda. Tolak unggahan besar sejak awal dengan 4xx final alih-alih membaca body.
Let your HTTP server or framework handle.it: Lascia che se ne occupi il tuo server HTTP o il framework. Rifiuta subito gli upload troppo grandi con un 4xx definitivo invece di leggere il corpo.
Let your HTTP server or framework handle.tr: Bunu HTTP sunucunuza veya çerçevenize bırakın. Büyük yüklemeleri gövdeyi okumak yerine nihai bir 4xx ile erkenden reddedin.
Let your HTTP server or framework handle.vi: Hãy để máy chủ HTTP hoặc framework của bạn xử lý. Từ chối sớm các tệp tải lên lớn bằng mã 4xx cuối cùng thay vì đọc body.
Let your HTTP server or framework handle.ru: Пусть это делает ваш HTTP-сервер или фреймворк. Отклоняйте большие загрузки заранее финальным кодом 4xx, не читая тело.
Let your HTTP server or framework handle.hi: इसे अपने HTTP सर्वर या फ़्रेमवर्क पर छोड़ दें। बड़े अपलोड को बॉडी पढ़े बिना शुरू में ही अंतिम 4xx से अस्वीकार करें।
Let your HTTP server or framework handle.pl: Pozwól, aby obsłużył to Twój serwer HTTP lub framework. Duże przesyłane pliki odrzucaj wcześnie ostatecznym kodem 4xx zamiast czytać treść.

The server agrees to change to the proto.es: El servidor acepta cambiar al protocolo que el cliente pidió en su encabezado Upgrade.
The server agrees to change to the proto.pt-BR: O servidor concorda em mudar para o protocolo que o cliente pediu no cabeçalho Upgrade.
The server agrees to change to the proto.fr: Le serveur accepte de passer au protocole demandé par le client dans son en-tête Upgrade.
The server agrees to change to the proto.de: Der Server stimmt dem Wechsel zu dem Protokoll zu, das der Client in seinem Upgrade-Header angefordert hat.
The server agrees to change to the proto.id: Server setuju untuk beralih ke protokol yang diminta klien melalui header Upgrade.
The server agrees to change to the proto.it: Il server accetta di passare al protocollo richiesto dal client nell'intestazione Upgrade.
The server agrees to change to the proto.tr: Sunucu, istemcinin Upgrade başlığında istediği protokole geçmeyi kabul ediyor.
The server agrees to change to the proto.vi: Máy chủ đồng ý chuyển sang giao thức mà máy khách yêu cầu trong header Upgrade.
The server agrees to change to the proto.ru: Сервер согласен перейти на протокол, который клиент запросил в заголовке Upgrade.
The server agrees to change to the proto.hi: क्लाइंट ने अपने Upgrade हेडर में जिस प्रोटोकॉल की माँग की थी, सर्वर उस पर जाने के लिए राज़ी है।
The server agrees to change to the proto.pl: Serwer zgadza się przełączyć na protokół, o który klient poprosił w nagłówku Upgrade.

Opening a WebSocket connection, or upgra.es: Al abrir una conexión WebSocket, o al pasar a HTTP/2 sobre texto plano.
Opening a WebSocket connection, or upgra.pt-BR: Abertura de uma conexão WebSocket ou upgrade para HTTP/2 sobre texto simples.
Opening a WebSocket connection, or upgra.fr: Ouverture d'une connexion WebSocket, ou passage à HTTP/2 en clair.
Opening a WebSocket connection, or upgra.de: Beim Aufbau einer WebSocket-Verbindung oder beim Upgrade auf HTTP/2 über Klartext.
Opening a WebSocket connection, or upgra.id: Membuka koneksi WebSocket, atau meningkatkan ke HTTP/2 melalui cleartext.
Opening a WebSocket connection, or upgra.it: Apertura di una connessione WebSocket, o passaggio a HTTP/2 in chiaro.
Opening a WebSocket connection, or upgra.tr: WebSocket bağlantısı açmak veya düz metin üzerinden HTTP/2'ye geçmek.
Opening a WebSocket connection, or upgra.vi: Mở kết nối WebSocket, hoặc nâng cấp lên HTTP/2 qua kết nối không mã hóa.
Opening a WebSocket connection, or upgra.ru: Открытие соединения WebSocket или переход на HTTP/2 поверх открытого текста.
Opening a WebSocket connection, or upgra.hi: WebSocket कनेक्शन खोलते समय, या क्लियरटेक्स्ट पर HTTP/2 में अपग्रेड करते समय।
Opening a WebSocket connection, or upgra.pl: Otwieranie połączenia WebSocket albo przejście na HTTP/2 przez nieszyfrowane połączenie.

Start speaking the new protocol on the s.es: Empieza a usar el nuevo protocolo en la misma conexión.
Start speaking the new protocol on the s.pt-BR: Comece a falar o novo protocolo na mesma conexão.
Start speaking the new protocol on the s.fr: Commencez à utiliser le nouveau protocole sur la même connexion.
Start speaking the new protocol on the s.de: Verwenden Sie auf derselben Verbindung das neue Protokoll.
Start speaking the new protocol on the s.id: Mulailah menggunakan protokol baru pada koneksi yang sama.
Start speaking the new protocol on the s.it: Inizia a usare il nuovo protocollo sulla stessa connessione.
Start speaking the new protocol on the s.tr: Aynı bağlantı üzerinde yeni protokolü konuşmaya başlayın.
Start speaking the new protocol on the s.vi: Bắt đầu dùng giao thức mới trên cùng kết nối.
Start speaking the new protocol on the s.ru: Начните использовать новый протокол в том же соединении.
Start speaking the new protocol on the s.hi: उसी कनेक्शन पर नए प्रोटोकॉल में बात करना शुरू करें।
Start speaking the new protocol on the s.pl: Zacznij używać nowego protokołu w tym samym połączeniu.

If WebSocket connections fail, check tha.es: Si las conexiones WebSocket fallan, comprueba que un proxy o balanceador de carga reenvíe los encabezados Upgrade y Connection.
If WebSocket connections fail, check tha.pt-BR: Se as conexões WebSocket falharem, verifique se algum proxy ou balanceador de carga repassa os cabeçalhos Upgrade e Connection.
If WebSocket connections fail, check tha.fr: Si les connexions WebSocket échouent, vérifiez qu'un proxy ou un répartiteur de charge transmet les en-têtes Upgrade et Connection.
If WebSocket connections fail, check tha.de: Wenn WebSocket-Verbindungen fehlschlagen, prüfen Sie, ob ein Proxy oder Load Balancer die Header Upgrade und Connection weiterleitet.
If WebSocket connections fail, check tha.id: Jika koneksi WebSocket gagal, periksa apakah proxy atau load balancer meneruskan header Upgrade dan Connection.
If WebSocket connections fail, check tha.it: Se le connessioni WebSocket falliscono, verifica che un proxy o un bilanciatore di carico inoltri le intestazioni Upgrade e Connection.
If WebSocket connections fail, check tha.tr: WebSocket bağlantıları başarısız oluyorsa bir vekil sunucunun veya yük dengeleyicinin Upgrade ve Connection başlıklarını ilettiğini kontrol edin.
If WebSocket connections fail, check tha.vi: Nếu kết nối WebSocket thất bại, hãy kiểm tra xem proxy hoặc bộ cân bằng tải có chuyển tiếp các header Upgrade và Connection không.
If WebSocket connections fail, check tha.ru: Если соединения WebSocket не устанавливаются, проверьте, что прокси или балансировщик нагрузки передаёт заголовки Upgrade и Connection.
If WebSocket connections fail, check tha.hi: अगर WebSocket कनेक्शन फ़ेल हों, तो जाँचें कि कोई प्रॉक्सी या लोड बैलेंसर Upgrade और Connection हेडर आगे भेज रहा है या नहीं।
If WebSocket connections fail, check tha.pl: Jeśli połączenia WebSocket zawodzą, sprawdź, czy serwer proxy lub load balancer przekazuje nagłówki Upgrade i Connection.

The server has accepted a WebDAV request.es: El servidor aceptó una solicitud WebDAV y sigue trabajando en ella, así que el cliente no debe agotar el tiempo de espera.
The server has accepted a WebDAV request.pt-BR: O servidor aceitou uma requisição WebDAV e ainda está processando, então o cliente não deve estourar o timeout.
The server has accepted a WebDAV request.fr: Le serveur a accepté une requête WebDAV et la traite encore, le client ne doit donc pas expirer.
The server has accepted a WebDAV request.de: Der Server hat eine WebDAV-Anfrage angenommen und arbeitet noch daran, daher sollte der Client kein Timeout auslösen.
The server has accepted a WebDAV request.id: Server telah menerima permintaan WebDAV dan masih memprosesnya, jadi klien sebaiknya tetap menunggu dan tidak menganggapnya timeout.
The server has accepted a WebDAV request.it: Il server ha accettato una richiesta WebDAV e la sta ancora elaborando, quindi il client non deve andare in timeout.
The server has accepted a WebDAV request.tr: Sunucu bir WebDAV isteğini kabul etti ve hâlâ üzerinde çalışıyor, bu yüzden istemci zaman aşımına uğramamalı.
The server has accepted a WebDAV request.vi: Máy chủ đã nhận một yêu cầu WebDAV và vẫn đang xử lý, nên máy khách không nên hết thời gian chờ.
The server has accepted a WebDAV request.ru: Сервер принял запрос WebDAV и ещё обрабатывает его, поэтому клиенту не следует завершать ожидание по тайм-ауту.
The server has accepted a WebDAV request.hi: सर्वर ने WebDAV रिक्वेस्ट स्वीकार कर ली है और अभी उस पर काम कर रहा है, इसलिए क्लाइंट को टाइमआउट नहीं करना चाहिए।
The server has accepted a WebDAV request.pl: Serwer przyjął żądanie WebDAV i nadal je przetwarza, więc klient nie powinien przerywać z powodu przekroczenia czasu.

Old WebDAV servers handling long operati.es: Servidores WebDAV antiguos que manejan operaciones largas. Los servidores modernos casi nunca lo envían.
Old WebDAV servers handling long operati.pt-BR: Servidores WebDAV antigos executando operações longas. Servidores modernos quase nunca enviam esse código.
Old WebDAV servers handling long operati.fr: Anciens serveurs WebDAV exécutant de longues opérations. Les serveurs modernes ne l'envoient presque jamais.
Old WebDAV servers handling long operati.de: Ältere WebDAV-Server bei langwierigen Operationen. Moderne Server senden ihn so gut wie nie.
Old WebDAV servers handling long operati.id: Server WebDAV lama yang menangani operasi panjang. Server modern hampir tidak pernah mengirimnya.
Old WebDAV servers handling long operati.it: Vecchi server WebDAV che gestiscono operazioni lunghe. I server moderni non lo inviano quasi mai.
Old WebDAV servers handling long operati.tr: Uzun işlemleri yürüten eski WebDAV sunucuları. Modern sunucular bunu neredeyse hiç göndermez.
Old WebDAV servers handling long operati.vi: Các máy chủ WebDAV cũ xử lý thao tác dài. Máy chủ hiện đại hầu như không bao giờ gửi mã này.
Old WebDAV servers handling long operati.ru: Старые серверы WebDAV при долгих операциях. Современные серверы почти никогда его не отправляют.
Old WebDAV servers handling long operati.hi: लंबे ऑपरेशन संभालने वाले पुराने WebDAV सर्वर। आधुनिक सर्वर इसे लगभग कभी नहीं भेजते।
Old WebDAV servers handling long operati.pl: Stare serwery WebDAV obsługujące długie operacje. Nowoczesne serwery prawie nigdy go nie wysyłają.

Keep waiting for the final response..fr: Continuez à attendre la réponse finale.
Keep waiting for the final response..de: Warten Sie weiter auf die endgültige Antwort.
Keep waiting for the final response..it: Continua ad attendere la risposta finale.
Keep waiting for the final response..vi: Tiếp tục chờ phản hồi cuối cùng.
Keep waiting for the final response..hi: अंतिम जवाब का इंतज़ार करते रहें।

Do not rely on it for new work. Return a.es: No dependas de él en desarrollos nuevos. Devuelve un estado final rápidamente, o usa 202 Accepted y una URL de estado.
Do not rely on it for new work. Return a.pt-BR: Não conte com ele em trabalhos novos. Retorne um status final rapidamente ou use 202 Accepted e uma URL de status.
Do not rely on it for new work. Return a.fr: Ne vous y fiez pas pour du nouveau code. Renvoyez rapidement un statut final, ou utilisez 202 Accepted et une URL de statut.
Do not rely on it for new work. Return a.de: Verlassen Sie sich bei neuen Entwicklungen nicht darauf. Geben Sie schnell einen finalen Status zurück oder verwenden Sie 202 Accepted und eine Status-URL.
Do not rely on it for new work. Return a.id: Jangan mengandalkannya untuk pekerjaan baru. Kembalikan status akhir dengan cepat, atau gunakan 202 Accepted dan URL status.
Do not rely on it for new work. Return a.it: Non farci affidamento per nuove implementazioni. Restituisci rapidamente uno stato finale, oppure usa 202 Accepted e un URL di stato.
Do not rely on it for new work. Return a.tr: Yeni işlerde buna güvenmeyin. Hızlıca nihai bir durum döndürün veya 202 Accepted ve bir durum URL'si kullanın.
Do not rely on it for new work. Return a.vi: Đừng dựa vào nó cho công việc mới. Hãy trả về mã trạng thái cuối cùng nhanh chóng, hoặc dùng 202 Accepted kèm URL trạng thái.
Do not rely on it for new work. Return a.ru: Не полагайтесь на него в новых разработках. Быстро возвращайте финальный статус или используйте 202 Accepted и URL статуса.
Do not rely on it for new work. Return a.hi: नए काम के लिए इस पर भरोसा न करें। जल्दी अंतिम स्टेटस लौटाएँ, या 202 Accepted और स्टेटस URL इस्तेमाल करें।
Do not rely on it for new work. Return a.pl: Nie polegaj na nim w nowych rozwiązaniach. Szybko zwróć ostateczny status albo użyj 202 Accepted i adresu URL statusu.

RFC 2518 §10.1 (not carried into RFC 491.hi: RFC 2518 §10.1 (RFC 4918 में आगे नहीं रखा गया)

Preliminary headers, usually Link: rel=p.es: Encabezados preliminares, normalmente Link: rel=preload, enviados antes de la respuesta final para que el navegador pueda empezar a descargar recursos.
Preliminary headers, usually Link: rel=p.pt-BR: Cabeçalhos preliminares, geralmente Link: rel=preload, enviados antes da resposta final para que o navegador possa começar a buscar os recursos.
Preliminary headers, usually Link: rel=p.fr: En-têtes préliminaires, généralement Link: rel=preload, envoyés avant la réponse finale pour que le navigateur puisse commencer à récupérer les ressources.
Preliminary headers, usually Link: rel=p.de: Vorläufige Header, meist Link: rel=preload, die vor der endgültigen Antwort gesendet werden, damit der Browser bereits mit dem Laden von Assets beginnen kann.
Preliminary headers, usually Link: rel=p.id: Header awal, biasanya Link: rel=preload, yang dikirim sebelum respons akhir agar browser dapat mulai mengambil aset.
Preliminary headers, usually Link: rel=p.it: Intestazioni preliminari, di solito Link: rel=preload, inviate prima della risposta finale in modo che il browser possa iniziare a scaricare le risorse.
Preliminary headers, usually Link: rel=p.tr: Genellikle Link: rel=preload olan, tarayıcının varlıkları getirmeye başlayabilmesi için nihai yanıttan önce gönderilen ön başlıklar.
Preliminary headers, usually Link: rel=p.vi: Các header sơ bộ, thường là Link: rel=preload, được gửi trước phản hồi cuối cùng để trình duyệt có thể bắt đầu tải tài nguyên.
Preliminary headers, usually Link: rel=p.ru: Предварительные заголовки, обычно Link: rel=preload, отправляемые до финального ответа, чтобы браузер мог начать загрузку ресурсов.
Preliminary headers, usually Link: rel=p.hi: शुरुआती हेडर, आम तौर पर Link: rel=preload, जो अंतिम जवाब से पहले भेजे जाते हैं ताकि ब्राउज़र एसेट मँगवाना शुरू कर सके।
Preliminary headers, usually Link: rel=p.pl: Wstępne nagłówki, zwykle Link: rel=preload, wysyłane przed ostateczną odpowiedzią, aby przeglądarka mogła zacząć pobierać zasoby.

Sites and CDNs that preload stylesheets.es: Sitios y CDN que precargan hojas de estilo y scripts mientras el servidor construye la página.
Sites and CDNs that preload stylesheets.pt-BR: Sites e CDNs que pré-carregam folhas de estilo e scripts enquanto o servidor monta a página.
Sites and CDNs that preload stylesheets.fr: Sites et CDN qui préchargent les feuilles de style et les scripts pendant que le serveur construit la page.
Sites and CDNs that preload stylesheets.de: Websites und CDNs, die Stylesheets und Skripte vorab laden, während der Server die Seite erzeugt.

Send it from your server or CDN to start.es: Envíalo desde tu servidor o CDN para que los recursos empiecen a cargarse antes. Úsalo solo para recursos que la página final necesite.

Send it from your server or CDN to start.fr: Envoyez-le depuis votre serveur ou votre CDN pour démarrer plus tôt le chargement des ressources. Ne l'utilisez que pour les ressources dont la page finale a besoin.
Send it from your server or CDN to start.de: Senden Sie ihn von Ihrem Server oder CDN, damit das Laden der Assets früher beginnt. Verwenden Sie ihn nur für Ressourcen, die die fertige Seite tatsächlich benötigt.
Send it from your server or CDN to start.id: Kirim dari server atau CDN Anda agar pemuatan aset dimulai lebih cepat. Gunakan hanya untuk sumber daya yang dibutuhkan halaman akhir.
Send it from your server or CDN to start.it: Invialo dal tuo server o dalla CDN per avviare prima il caricamento delle risorse. Usalo solo per le risorse di cui la pagina finale ha bisogno.
Send it from your server or CDN to start.tr: Varlıkların daha erken yüklenmeye başlaması için sunucunuzdan veya CDN'inizden gönderin. Yalnızca nihai sayfanın ihtiyaç duyduğu kaynaklar için kullanın.
Send it from your server or CDN to start.vi: Gửi từ máy chủ hoặc CDN của bạn để bắt đầu tải tài nguyên sớm hơn. Chỉ dùng cho các tài nguyên mà trang cuối cùng cần.
Send it from your server or CDN to start.ru: Отправляйте его со своего сервера или CDN, чтобы ресурсы начали загружаться раньше. Используйте только для ресурсов, нужных итоговой странице.
Send it from your server or CDN to start.hi: एसेट जल्दी लोड कराने के लिए इसे अपने सर्वर या CDN से भेजें। इसे सिर्फ़ उन संसाधनों के लिए इस्तेमाल करें जो अंतिम पेज को चाहिए।
Send it from your server or CDN to start.pl: Wysyłaj go z serwera lub CDN, aby szybciej rozpocząć ładowanie zasobów. Używaj go tylko dla zasobów potrzebnych na ostatecznej stronie.

Use it when you return content. Use 201.es: Úsalo cuando devuelvas contenido. Usa 201 para creaciones y 204 cuando no haya nada que devolver.

Use it when you return content. Use 201.hi: जब आप सामग्री लौटाएँ तब इसे इस्तेमाल करें। बनाने के लिए 201 और लौटाने को कुछ न होने पर 204 इस्तेमाल करें।

Return it for asynchronous work, ideally.it: Restituiscilo per il lavoro asincrono, possibilmente con un link che il client possa interrogare o con una promessa di webhook.
Return it for asynchronous work, ideally.tr: Eşzamansız işler için döndürün; ideal olarak istemcinin yoklayabileceği bir bağlantı veya webhook sözüyle.
Return it for asynchronous work, ideally.vi: Trả về cho công việc bất đồng bộ, tốt nhất kèm liên kết để máy khách thăm dò hoặc cam kết gửi webhook.
Return it for asynchronous work, ideally.ru: Возвращайте его для асинхронной работы, лучше со ссылкой, которую клиент может опрашивать, или с обещанием вебхука.
Return it for asynchronous work, ideally.hi: एसिंक्रोनस काम के लिए लौटाएँ, बेहतर होगा कि ऐसे लिंक के साथ जिसे क्लाइंट पोल कर सके या वेबहुक के वादे के साथ।
Return it for asynchronous work, ideally.pl: Zwracaj go dla pracy asynchronicznej, najlepiej z linkiem, który klient może odpytywać, lub z obietnicą webhooka.

The response is a success, but a proxy c.es: La respuesta es exitosa, pero un proxy cambió el contenido respecto a lo que envió el servidor de origen.
The response is a success, but a proxy c.pt-BR: A resposta é um sucesso, mas um proxy alterou o conteúdo em relação ao que o servidor de origem enviou.
The response is a success, but a proxy c.fr: La réponse est un succès, mais un proxy a modifié le contenu par rapport à ce que le serveur d'origine avait envoyé.
The response is a success, but a proxy c.de: Die Antwort ist ein Erfolg, aber ein Proxy hat den Inhalt gegenüber dem verändert, was der Ursprungsserver gesendet hat.
The response is a success, but a proxy c.id: Respons berhasil, tetapi sebuah proxy mengubah konten dari yang dikirim server asal.
The response is a success, but a proxy c.it: La risposta indica successo, ma un proxy ha modificato il contenuto rispetto a quello inviato dal server di origine.
The response is a success, but a proxy c.tr: Yanıt başarılı, ancak bir vekil sunucu içeriği kaynak sunucunun gönderdiğinden farklı hale getirdi.
The response is a success, but a proxy c.vi: Phản hồi thành công, nhưng một proxy đã thay đổi nội dung so với những gì máy chủ gốc gửi.
The response is a success, but a proxy c.ru: Ответ успешный, но прокси изменил содержимое по сравнению с тем, что отправил исходный сервер.
The response is a success, but a proxy c.hi: जवाब सफल है, लेकिन किसी प्रॉक्सी ने सामग्री को ऑरिजिन सर्वर की भेजी सामग्री से बदल दिया है।
The response is a success, but a proxy c.pl: Odpowiedź jest sukcesem, ale serwer proxy zmienił treść w stosunku do tego, co wysłał serwer źródłowy.

Transforming proxies. Very rare on the o.es: Proxies que transforman contenido. Muy raro en la web abierta.
Transforming proxies. Very rare on the o.pt-BR: Proxies que transformam o conteúdo. Muito raro na web aberta.
Transforming proxies. Very rare on the o.fr: Proxys de transformation. Très rare sur le web public.
Transforming proxies. Very rare on the o.de: Transformierende Proxys. Im offenen Web sehr selten.
Transforming proxies. Very rare on the o.id: Proxy yang melakukan transformasi. Sangat jarang di web terbuka.
Transforming proxies. Very rare on the o.it: Proxy che trasformano il contenuto. Molto raro sul web aperto.
Transforming proxies. Very rare on the o.tr: Dönüştürücü vekil sunucular. Açık web'de çok nadir.
Transforming proxies. Very rare on the o.vi: Các proxy biến đổi nội dung. Rất hiếm trên web mở.
Transforming proxies. Very rare on the o.ru: Преобразующие прокси. В открытом интернете встречается очень редко.
Transforming proxies. Very rare on the o.hi: सामग्री बदलने वाली प्रॉक्सी। खुले वेब पर बहुत दुर्लभ।
Transforming proxies. Very rare on the o.pl: Serwery proxy przekształcające treść. Bardzo rzadko w otwartym internecie.

Treat the content as usable, but know it.es: Trata el contenido como utilizable, pero ten en cuenta que puede diferir del original.
Treat the content as usable, but know it.pt-BR: Trate o conteúdo como utilizável, mas saiba que ele pode diferir do da origem.
Treat the content as usable, but know it.fr: Considérez le contenu comme utilisable, mais sachez qu'il peut différer de celui de l'origine.
Treat the content as usable, but know it.de: Betrachten Sie den Inhalt als verwendbar, aber beachten Sie, dass er vom Original des Ursprungsservers abweichen kann.
Treat the content as usable, but know it.id: Anggap kontennya dapat digunakan, tetapi ketahui bahwa isinya mungkin berbeda dari server asal.
Treat the content as usable, but know it.it: Considera il contenuto utilizzabile, ma sappi che potrebbe differire da quello dell'origine.
Treat the content as usable, but know it.tr: İçeriği kullanılabilir sayın, ama kaynağınkinden farklı olabileceğini bilin.
Treat the content as usable, but know it.vi: Coi nội dung là dùng được, nhưng biết rằng nó có thể khác với bản của máy chủ gốc.
Treat the content as usable, but know it.ru: Считайте содержимое пригодным, но помните, что оно может отличаться от исходного.
Treat the content as usable, but know it.hi: सामग्री को उपयोगी मानें, पर जानें कि वह ऑरिजिन की सामग्री से अलग हो सकती है।
Treat the content as usable, but know it.pl: Traktuj treść jako użyteczną, ale pamiętaj, że może różnić się od treści serwera źródłowego.

A proxy that modifies responses may send.es: Un proxy que modifica respuestas puede enviarlo. La mayoría no lo hace y simplemente deja pasar el 200.
A proxy that modifies responses may send.pt-BR: Um proxy que modifica respostas pode enviá-lo. A maioria não faz isso e apenas repassa o 200.
A proxy that modifies responses may send.fr: Un proxy qui modifie les réponses peut l'envoyer. La plupart ne le font pas et laissent simplement passer le 200.
A proxy that modifies responses may send.de: Ein Proxy, der Antworten verändert, kann ihn senden. Die meisten tun das nicht und reichen einfach 200 durch.
A proxy that modifies responses may send.id: Proxy yang memodifikasi respons mungkin mengirimnya. Kebanyakan tidak, dan hanya meneruskan 200.
A proxy that modifies responses may send.it: Può essere inviato da un proxy che modifica le risposte. La maggior parte non lo fa e lascia passare il 200.
A proxy that modifies responses may send.tr: Yanıtları değiştiren bir vekil sunucu bunu gönderebilir. Çoğu göndermez ve 200'ü olduğu gibi iletir.
A proxy that modifies responses may send.vi: Proxy có chỉnh sửa phản hồi có thể gửi mã này. Hầu hết không làm vậy mà chỉ chuyển tiếp 200.
A proxy that modifies responses may send.ru: Его может отправлять прокси, изменяющий ответы. Большинство этого не делает и просто пропускает 200.
A proxy that modifies responses may send.hi: जवाब बदलने वाली प्रॉक्सी इसे भेज सकती है। ज़्यादातर नहीं भेजतीं और बस 200 आगे बढ़ा देती हैं।
A proxy that modifies responses may send.pl: Może go wysłać serwer proxy modyfikujący odpowiedzi. Większość tego nie robi i po prostu przekazuje 200.

The request succeeded and there is delib.es: La solicitud tuvo éxito y, a propósito, no hay cuerpo.
The request succeeded and there is delib.pt-BR: A requisição foi bem-sucedida e, de propósito, não há corpo.
The request succeeded and there is delib.fr: La requête a réussi et il n'y a volontairement pas de corps.
The request succeeded and there is delib.de: Die Anfrage war erfolgreich, und es gibt absichtlich keinen Body.
The request succeeded and there is delib.id: Permintaan berhasil dan memang sengaja tidak ada body.
The request succeeded and there is delib.it: La richiesta è riuscita e di proposito non c'è alcun corpo.
The request succeeded and there is delib.tr: İstek başarılı oldu ve bilerek gövde yok.
The request succeeded and there is delib.vi: Yêu cầu thành công và cố ý không có body.
The request succeeded and there is delib.ru: Запрос выполнен успешно, и тела намеренно нет.
The request succeeded and there is delib.hi: रिक्वेस्ट सफल रही और जानबूझकर कोई बॉडी नहीं है।
The request succeeded and there is delib.pl: Żądanie się powiodło i celowo nie ma treści.

DELETE and PUT calls, or form saves that.es: Llamadas DELETE y PUT, o guardados de formularios que no necesitan que se devuelva una página. También es la respuesta a las solicitudes preflight de CORS.
DELETE and PUT calls, or form saves that.pt-BR: Chamadas DELETE e PUT, ou salvamentos de formulário que não precisam de uma página de volta. Também é a resposta às requisições preflight de CORS.
DELETE and PUT calls, or form saves that.fr: Appels DELETE et PUT, ou enregistrements de formulaire qui n'ont pas besoin d'une page en retour. C'est aussi la réponse aux requêtes preflight CORS.
DELETE and PUT calls, or form saves that.de: DELETE- und PUT-Aufrufe oder Formular-Speichervorgänge, die keine Seite als Antwort benötigen. Außerdem die Antwort auf CORS-Preflight-Requests.
DELETE and PUT calls, or form saves that.id: Panggilan DELETE dan PUT, atau penyimpanan formulir yang tidak memerlukan halaman balasan. Juga jawaban untuk permintaan preflight CORS.
DELETE and PUT calls, or form saves that.it: Chiamate DELETE e PUT, o salvataggi di moduli che non richiedono una pagina in risposta. È anche la risposta alle richieste preflight CORS.
DELETE and PUT calls, or form saves that.tr: DELETE ve PUT çağrıları veya sayfa geri döndürmesi gerekmeyen form kayıtları. Ayrıca CORS ön kontrol isteklerinin yanıtı.
DELETE and PUT calls, or form saves that.vi: Các lệnh DELETE và PUT, hoặc lưu biểu mẫu không cần trả lại trang. Cũng là câu trả lời cho các yêu cầu preflight CORS.
DELETE and PUT calls, or form saves that.ru: Вызовы DELETE и PUT или сохранение форм, которым не нужна страница в ответ. Также ответ на предварительные запросы CORS.
DELETE and PUT calls, or form saves that.hi: DELETE और PUT कॉल, या वे फ़ॉर्म सेव जिन्हें वापस पेज नहीं चाहिए। CORS प्रीफ़्लाइट रिक्वेस्ट का जवाब भी यही है।
DELETE and PUT calls, or form saves that.pl: Wywołania DELETE i PUT albo zapisy formularzy, które nie wymagają zwrotu strony. Także odpowiedź na żądania wstępne CORS (preflight).

Do not try to parse a body. Keep the cur.es: No intentes analizar un cuerpo. Mantén la página o el estado actual.
Do not try to parse a body. Keep the cur.pt-BR: Não tente interpretar um corpo. Mantenha a página ou o estado atual.
Do not try to parse a body. Keep the cur.fr: N'essayez pas d'analyser un corps. Conservez la page ou l'état actuel.
Do not try to parse a body. Keep the cur.de: Versuchen Sie nicht, einen Body zu parsen. Behalten Sie die aktuelle Seite bzw. den aktuellen Zustand bei.
Do not try to parse a body. Keep the cur.id: Jangan coba mem-parse body. Pertahankan halaman atau state saat ini.
Do not try to parse a body. Keep the cur.it: Non cercare di analizzare un corpo. Mantieni la pagina o lo stato corrente.
Do not try to parse a body. Keep the cur.tr: Gövdeyi ayrıştırmaya çalışmayın. Geçerli sayfayı veya durumu koruyun.
Do not try to parse a body. Keep the cur.vi: Đừng cố phân tích body. Giữ nguyên trang hoặc trạng thái hiện tại.
Do not try to parse a body. Keep the cur.ru: Не пытайтесь разбирать тело. Оставьте текущую страницу или состояние.
Do not try to parse a body. Keep the cur.hi: बॉडी पार्स करने की कोशिश न करें। मौजूदा पेज या स्थिति बनाए रखें।
Do not try to parse a body. Keep the cur.pl: Nie próbuj analizować treści. Zachowaj bieżącą stronę lub stan.

Use it for successful actions that retur.es: Úsalo para acciones exitosas que no devuelven nada. Un cuerpo enviado con 204 no es válido.
Use it for successful actions that retur.pt-BR: Use em ações bem-sucedidas que não retornam nada. Um corpo enviado com 204 é inválido.
Use it for successful actions that retur.fr: Utilisez-le pour les actions réussies qui ne renvoient rien. Un corps envoyé avec 204 est invalide.
Use it for successful actions that retur.de: Verwenden Sie ihn für erfolgreiche Aktionen, die nichts zurückgeben. Ein Body, der mit 204 gesendet wird, ist ungültig.
Use it for successful actions that retur.id: Gunakan untuk aksi berhasil yang tidak mengembalikan apa pun. Body yang dikirim bersama 204 tidak valid.
Use it for successful actions that retur.it: Usalo per le azioni riuscite che non restituiscono nulla. Un corpo inviato con 204 non è valido.
Use it for successful actions that retur.tr: Hiçbir şey döndürmeyen başarılı eylemler için kullanın. 204 ile gönderilen gövde geçersizdir.
Use it for successful actions that retur.vi: Dùng cho các hành động thành công không trả về gì. Body gửi kèm 204 là không hợp lệ.
Use it for successful actions that retur.ru: Используйте для успешных действий, не возвращающих ничего. Тело, отправленное с 204, недопустимо.
Use it for successful actions that retur.hi: उन सफल कार्रवाइयों के लिए इस्तेमाल करें जो कुछ नहीं लौटातीं। 204 के साथ भेजी गई बॉडी अमान्य है।
Use it for successful actions that retur.pl: Używaj go dla udanych akcji, które nic nie zwracają. Treść wysłana z 204 jest nieprawidłowa.

The request succeeded and the client sho.es: La solicitud tuvo éxito y el cliente debe restablecer el formulario o la vista que la envió.
The request succeeded and the client sho.pt-BR: A requisição foi bem-sucedida e o cliente deve limpar o formulário ou a visualização que a enviou.
The request succeeded and the client sho.fr: La requête a réussi et le client doit réinitialiser le formulaire ou la vue qui l'a envoyée.
The request succeeded and the client sho.de: Die Anfrage war erfolgreich, und der Client sollte das Formular bzw. die Ansicht, von der sie ausging, zurücksetzen.
The request succeeded and the client sho.id: Permintaan berhasil dan klien sebaiknya mereset formulir atau tampilan yang mengirimnya.
The request succeeded and the client sho.it: La richiesta è riuscita e il client deve reimpostare il modulo o la vista che l'ha inviata.
The request succeeded and the client sho.tr: İstek başarılı oldu ve istemci, isteği gönderen formu veya görünümü sıfırlamalıdır.
The request succeeded and the client sho.vi: Yêu cầu thành công và máy khách nên đặt lại biểu mẫu hoặc chế độ xem đã gửi yêu cầu.
The request succeeded and the client sho.ru: Запрос выполнен успешно, и клиенту следует сбросить форму или представление, которые его отправили.
The request succeeded and the client sho.hi: रिक्वेस्ट सफल रही और क्लाइंट को उस फ़ॉर्म या व्यू को रीसेट कर देना चाहिए जिसने उसे भेजा था।
The request succeeded and the client sho.pl: Żądanie się powiodło, a klient powinien zresetować formularz lub widok, który je wysłał.

Almost never seen in practice..es: Casi nunca se ve en la práctica.
Almost never seen in practice..de: In der Praxis fast nie zu sehen.

Almost never seen in practice..vi: Hầu như không bao giờ gặp trong thực tế.

Clear the input form so the user can ent.es: Limpia el formulario de entrada para que el usuario pueda ingresar datos nuevos.
Clear the input form so the user can ent.pt-BR: Limpe o formulário de entrada para que o usuário possa digitar novos dados.
Clear the input form so the user can ent.fr: Videz le formulaire de saisie pour que l'utilisateur puisse entrer de nouvelles données.

Clear the input form so the user can ent.it: Svuota il modulo di inserimento così che l'utente possa inserire nuovi dati.

Clear the input form so the user can ent.ru: Очистите форму ввода, чтобы пользователь мог ввести новые данные.
Clear the input form so the user can ent.hi: इनपुट फ़ॉर्म साफ़ करें ताकि यूज़र नया डेटा दर्ज कर सके।
Clear the input form so the user can ent.pl: Wyczyść formularz, aby użytkownik mógł wprowadzić nowe dane.

Prefer 204 or a redirect; client support.es: Mejor usa 204 o una redirección; el soporte de los clientes para 205 es escaso.
Prefer 204 or a redirect; client support.pt-BR: Prefira 204 ou um redirecionamento; o suporte dos clientes ao 205 é fraco.
Prefer 204 or a redirect; client support.fr: Préférez 204 ou une redirection ; la prise en charge de 205 par les clients est faible.
Prefer 204 or a redirect; client support.de: Bevorzugen Sie 204 oder eine Weiterleitung; 205 wird von Clients nur lückenhaft unterstützt.
Prefer 204 or a redirect; client support.id: Sebaiknya gunakan 204 atau redirect; dukungan klien untuk 205 minim.
Prefer 204 or a redirect; client support.it: Preferisci 204 o un reindirizzamento; il supporto dei client per il 205 è scarso.
Prefer 204 or a redirect; client support.tr: 204'ü veya bir yönlendirmeyi tercih edin; istemcilerin 205 desteği zayıf.
Prefer 204 or a redirect; client support.vi: Nên dùng 204 hoặc chuyển hướng; hỗ trợ 205 ở máy khách còn ít.
Prefer 204 or a redirect; client support.ru: Лучше использовать 204 или перенаправление; поддержка 205 в клиентах слабая.
Prefer 204 or a redirect; client support.hi: 204 या रीडायरेक्ट को प्राथमिकता दें; 205 के लिए क्लाइंट सपोर्ट कम है।
Prefer 204 or a redirect; client support.pl: Wybierz raczej 204 lub przekierowanie; obsługa 205 przez klientów jest słaba.

The server is sending only the byte rang.es: El servidor envía solo el rango de bytes que pidió el cliente.
The server is sending only the byte rang.pt-BR: O servidor está enviando apenas o intervalo de bytes que o cliente pediu.
The server is sending only the byte rang.fr: Le serveur n'envoie que la plage d'octets demandée par le client.
The server is sending only the byte rang.de: Der Server sendet nur den Byte-Bereich, den der Client angefordert hat.
The server is sending only the byte rang.id: Server hanya mengirim rentang byte yang diminta klien.
The server is sending only the byte rang.it: Il server sta inviando solo l'intervallo di byte richiesto dal client.
The server is sending only the byte rang.tr: Sunucu yalnızca istemcinin istediği bayt aralığını gönderiyor.
The server is sending only the byte rang.vi: Máy chủ chỉ gửi đúng khoảng byte mà máy khách yêu cầu.
The server is sending only the byte rang.ru: Сервер отправляет только тот диапазон байтов, который запросил клиент.
The server is sending only the byte rang.hi: सर्वर सिर्फ़ वही बाइट रेंज भेज रहा है जो क्लाइंट ने माँगी थी।
The server is sending only the byte rang.pl: Serwer wysyła tylko ten zakres bajtów, o który poprosił klient.

Video and audio seeking, resumed downloa.es: Búsqueda en video y audio, descargas reanudadas y descargas de archivos grandes que usan el encabezado Range.
Video and audio seeking, resumed downloa.pt-BR: Seek em vídeo e áudio, downloads retomados e buscas de arquivos grandes que usam o cabeçalho Range.
Video and audio seeking, resumed downloa.fr: Navigation dans les vidéos et l'audio, reprises de téléchargement et récupération de gros fichiers avec l'en-tête Range.
Video and audio seeking, resumed downloa.de: Vor- und Zurückspulen in Video und Audio, fortgesetzte Downloads und Abrufe großer Dateien mit dem Range-Header.
Video and audio seeking, resumed downloa.id: Seeking video dan audio, unduhan yang dilanjutkan, dan pengambilan file besar yang menggunakan header Range.
Video and audio seeking, resumed downloa.it: Ricerca in video e audio, download ripresi e recupero di file di grandi dimensioni tramite l'intestazione Range.
Video and audio seeking, resumed downloa.tr: Video ve ses ileri-geri sarma, kaldığı yerden sürdürülen indirmeler ve Range başlığını kullanan büyük dosya getirmeleri.
Video and audio seeking, resumed downloa.vi: Tua video và âm thanh, tiếp tục tải xuống, và tải các tệp lớn dùng header Range.
Video and audio seeking, resumed downloa.ru: Перемотка видео и аудио, возобновление загрузок и скачивание больших файлов с заголовком Range.
Video and audio seeking, resumed downloa.hi: वीडियो और ऑडियो में आगे-पीछे जाना, रुके हुए डाउनलोड दोबारा शुरू करना, और Range हेडर इस्तेमाल करने वाले बड़ी फ़ाइलों के फ़ेच।
Video and audio seeking, resumed downloa.pl: Przewijanie wideo i audio, wznawiane pobieranie oraz pobieranie dużych plików z nagłówkiem Range.

Join the ranges using Content-Range. Han.es: Une los rangos usando Content-Range. Manéjalo cuando construyas un descargador.
Join the ranges using Content-Range. Han.pt-BR: Junte os intervalos usando Content-Range. Trate isso ao construir um downloader.
Join the ranges using Content-Range. Han.fr: Assemblez les plages à l'aide de Content-Range. Gérez-le lorsque vous écrivez un outil de téléchargement.

Follow Location, update bookmarks and li.es: Sigue Location, actualiza marcadores y enlaces, y espera que los buscadores trasladen su posicionamiento a la nueva URL.

Use it for permanent moves and keep it i.es: Úsalo para movimientos permanentes y mantenlo durante mucho tiempo. Los clientes pueden convertir un POST en GET al seguirlo; usa 308 para evitarlo.

Use it for permanent moves and keep it i.fr: Utilisez-le pour les déplacements permanents et gardez-le en place longtemps. Les clients peuvent transformer un POST en GET en le suivant ; utilisez 308 pour l'éviter.

Use it for permanent moves and keep it i.ru: Используйте для постоянных переездов и сохраняйте надолго. Клиенты могут заменить POST на GET при переходе; чтобы этого избежать, используйте 308.
Use it for permanent moves and keep it i.hi: स्थायी बदलाव के लिए इस्तेमाल करें और इसे लंबे समय तक बनाए रखें। इसे फ़ॉलो करते समय क्लाइंट POST को GET में बदल सकते हैं; इससे बचने के लिए 308 इस्तेमाल करें।
Use it for permanent moves and keep it i.pl: Używaj go dla trwałych przeniesień i zachowaj na długo. Klienci mogą zamienić POST na GET, gdy za nim podążają; użyj 308, aby tego uniknąć.
