Broken JSON, missing required fields, in.fr: JSON cassé, champs obligatoires manquants, valeurs de requête invalides, en-tête trop volumineux ou cookie incorrect.
Broken JSON, missing required fields, in.de: Defektes JSON, fehlende Pflichtfelder, ungültige Query-Werte, ein zu großer Header oder ein fehlerhaftes Cookie.
Broken JSON, missing required fields, in.id: JSON rusak, field wajib yang hilang, nilai query tidak valid, header terlalu besar, atau cookie yang rusak.
Broken JSON, missing required fields, in.it: JSON non valido, campi obbligatori mancanti, valori di query non validi, un'intestazione troppo grande o un cookie errato.
Broken JSON, missing required fields, in.tr: Bozuk JSON, eksik zorunlu alanlar, geçersiz sorgu değerleri, aşırı büyük bir başlık veya hatalı bir çerez.
Broken JSON, missing required fields, in.vi: JSON bị lỗi, thiếu trường bắt buộc, giá trị query không hợp lệ, header quá lớn hoặc cookie hỏng.
Broken JSON, missing required fields, in.ru: Испорченный JSON, отсутствующие обязательные поля, недопустимые значения запроса, слишком большой заголовок или неверный cookie.
Broken JSON, missing required fields, in.hi: टूटा हुआ JSON, ज़रूरी फ़ील्ड का न होना, अमान्य क्वेरी वैल्यू, बहुत बड़ा हेडर या ख़राब कुकी।
Broken JSON, missing required fields, in.pl: Uszkodzony JSON, brakujące wymagane pola, nieprawidłowe wartości zapytania, zbyt duży nagłówek lub zły plik cookie.

Check the request syntax, headers and bo.es: Revisa la sintaxis, los encabezados y el cuerpo de la solicitud. No reintentes la misma solicitud.
Check the request syntax, headers and bo.pt-BR: Verifique a sintaxe, os cabeçalhos e o corpo da requisição. Não repita a mesma requisição.
Check the request syntax, headers and bo.fr: Vérifiez la syntaxe, les en-têtes et le corps de la requête. Ne renvoyez pas la même requête.
Check the request syntax, headers and bo.de: Prüfen Sie Syntax, Header und Body der Anfrage. Wiederholen Sie dieselbe Anfrage nicht.
Check the request syntax, headers and bo.id: Periksa sintaks permintaan, header, dan body. Jangan ulangi permintaan yang sama.
Check the request syntax, headers and bo.it: Controlla la sintassi della richiesta, le intestazioni e il corpo. Non ripetere la stessa richiesta.
Check the request syntax, headers and bo.tr: İstek söz dizimini, başlıkları ve gövdeyi kontrol edin. Aynı isteği yeniden denemeyin.
Check the request syntax, headers and bo.vi: Kiểm tra cú pháp, header và body của yêu cầu. Đừng thử lại cùng yêu cầu.
Check the request syntax, headers and bo.ru: Проверьте синтаксис запроса, заголовки и тело. Не повторяйте тот же запрос.
Check the request syntax, headers and bo.hi: रिक्वेस्ट का सिंटैक्स, हेडर और बॉडी जाँचें। वही रिक्वेस्ट दोबारा न भेजें।
Check the request syntax, headers and bo.pl: Sprawdź składnię żądania, nagłówki i treść. Nie ponawiaj tego samego żądania.

Return a body that says what was wrong..es: Devuelve un cuerpo que indique qué estuvo mal. No uses 400 para autenticación ni para recursos inexistentes.
Return a body that says what was wrong..pt-BR: Retorne um corpo que diga o que estava errado. Não use 400 para autenticação ou recursos inexistentes.
Return a body that says what was wrong..fr: Renvoyez un corps qui indique ce qui n'allait pas. N'utilisez pas 400 pour l'authentification ou les ressources manquantes.
Return a body that says what was wrong..de: Geben Sie einen Body zurück, der angibt, was falsch war. Verwenden Sie 400 nicht für Authentifizierung oder fehlende Ressourcen.
Return a body that says what was wrong..id: Kembalikan body yang menjelaskan apa yang salah. Jangan gunakan 400 untuk autentikasi atau sumber daya yang hilang.
Return a body that says what was wrong..it: Restituisci un corpo che spieghi cosa non andava. Non usare 400 per l'autenticazione o per risorse mancanti.
Return a body that says what was wrong..tr: Neyin yanlış olduğunu söyleyen bir gövde döndürün. Kimlik doğrulama veya eksik kaynaklar için 400 kullanmayın.
Return a body that says what was wrong..vi: Trả về body nêu rõ lỗi ở đâu. Đừng dùng 400 cho xác thực hoặc tài nguyên không tồn tại.
Return a body that says what was wrong..ru: Возвращайте тело, объясняющее, что было не так. Не используйте 400 для аутентификации или отсутствующих ресурсов.
Return a body that says what was wrong..hi: ऐसी बॉडी लौटाएँ जो बताए कि क्या ग़लत था। ऑथेंटिकेशन या ग़ायब संसाधनों के लिए 400 इस्तेमाल न करें।
Return a body that says what was wrong..pl: Zwróć treść, która mówi, co było nie tak. Nie używaj 400 do uwierzytelniania ani brakujących zasobów.

The request lacks valid authentication,.es: La solicitud carece de autenticación válida, por lo que no se identifica al usuario.
The request lacks valid authentication,.pt-BR: A requisição não tem autenticação válida, então o usuário não está identificado.
The request lacks valid authentication,.fr: La requête n'a pas d'authentification valide, l'utilisateur n'est donc pas identifié.
The request lacks valid authentication,.de: Der Anfrage fehlt eine gültige Authentifizierung, daher ist der Benutzer nicht identifiziert.
The request lacks valid authentication,.id: Permintaan tidak memiliki autentikasi yang valid, sehingga pengguna tidak teridentifikasi.
The request lacks valid authentication,.it: La richiesta non contiene un'autenticazione valida, quindi l'utente non è identificato.
The request lacks valid authentication,.tr: İstekte geçerli bir kimlik doğrulaması yok, bu yüzden kullanıcı tanımlanamıyor.
The request lacks valid authentication,.vi: Yêu cầu thiếu thông tin xác thực hợp lệ, nên người dùng chưa được nhận diện.
The request lacks valid authentication,.ru: В запросе нет действительной аутентификации, поэтому пользователь не определён.
The request lacks valid authentication,.hi: रिक्वेस्ट में मान्य ऑथेंटिकेशन नहीं है, इसलिए यूज़र की पहचान नहीं हुई।
The request lacks valid authentication,.pl: Żądanie nie ma prawidłowego uwierzytelnienia, więc użytkownik nie jest zidentyfikowany.

A missing, expired or wrong token, API k.es: Un token, clave de API o contraseña ausente, vencido o incorrecto. El nombre dice no autorizado, pero el significado es no autenticado.
A missing, expired or wrong token, API k.pt-BR: Um token, chave de API ou senha ausente, expirado ou errado. O nome diz "unauthorized", mas o significado é "não autenticado".
A missing, expired or wrong token, API k.fr: Jeton, clé d'API ou mot de passe manquant, expiré ou incorrect. Le nom dit « unauthorized » mais le sens est « non authentifié ».
A missing, expired or wrong token, API k.de: Ein fehlendes, abgelaufenes oder falsches Token, ein ebensolcher API-Schlüssel oder ein falsches Passwort. Der Name besagt "unauthorised", gemeint ist aber "nicht authentifiziert".
A missing, expired or wrong token, API k.id: Token, API key, atau kata sandi yang hilang, kedaluwarsa, atau salah. Namanya "Unauthorized" (tidak berwenang), tetapi maksudnya belum terautentikasi.
A missing, expired or wrong token, API k.it: Un token, una chiave API o una password mancante, scaduta o errata. Il nome dice non autorizzato, ma il significato è non autenticato.
A missing, expired or wrong token, API k.tr: Eksik, süresi dolmuş veya yanlış bir belirteç, API anahtarı ya da parola. Ad "yetkisiz" der ama anlamı kimliği doğrulanmamıştır.
A missing, expired or wrong token, API k.vi: Token, khóa API hoặc mật khẩu bị thiếu, hết hạn hoặc sai. Tên gọi là unauthorised nhưng ý nghĩa là chưa xác thực.
A missing, expired or wrong token, API k.ru: Отсутствующий, просроченный или неверный токен, ключ API или пароль. Название говорит «неавторизован», но смысл — «не аутентифицирован».
A missing, expired or wrong token, API k.hi: ग़ायब, एक्सपायर या ग़लत टोकन, API की या पासवर्ड। नाम अनधिकृत कहता है लेकिन मतलब अप्रमाणित है।
A missing, expired or wrong token, API k.pl: Brakujący, wygasły lub błędny token, klucz API lub hasło. Nazwa mówi o braku autoryzacji, ale znaczenie to brak uwierzytelnienia.

Log in or send valid credentials, then r.es: Inicia sesión o envía credenciales válidas y vuelve a intentarlo. Renueva el token vencido.
Log in or send valid credentials, then r.pt-BR: Faça login ou envie credenciais válidas e tente de novo. Renove um token expirado.
Log in or send valid credentials, then r.fr: Connectez-vous ou envoyez des identifiants valides, puis réessayez. Renouvelez un jeton expiré.
Log in or send valid credentials, then r.de: Melden Sie sich an oder senden Sie gültige Zugangsdaten und versuchen Sie es dann erneut. Erneuern Sie ein abgelaufenes Token.
Log in or send valid credentials, then r.id: Login atau kirim kredensial yang valid, lalu coba lagi. Perbarui token yang kedaluwarsa.
Log in or send valid credentials, then r.it: Accedi o invia credenziali valide, poi riprova. Aggiorna un token scaduto.
Log in or send valid credentials, then r.tr: Oturum açın veya geçerli kimlik bilgileri gönderin, ardından yeniden deneyin. Süresi dolan belirteci yenileyin.
Log in or send valid credentials, then r.vi: Đăng nhập hoặc gửi thông tin xác thực hợp lệ, rồi thử lại. Làm mới token đã hết hạn.
Log in or send valid credentials, then r.ru: Войдите или отправьте действительные учётные данные и повторите. Обновите просроченный токен.
Log in or send valid credentials, then r.hi: लॉग इन करें या मान्य क्रेडेंशियल भेजें, फिर दोबारा कोशिश करें। एक्सपायर हुआ टोकन रीफ़्रेश करें।
Log in or send valid credentials, then r.pl: Zaloguj się lub wyślij prawidłowe dane uwierzytelniające, a potem spróbuj ponownie. Odśwież wygasły token.

Include a WWW-Authenticate header. Use 4.es: Incluye un encabezado WWW-Authenticate. Usa 403 cuando el usuario es conocido pero no tiene permiso.
Include a WWW-Authenticate header. Use 4.pt-BR: Inclua um cabeçalho WWW-Authenticate. Use 403 quando o usuário é conhecido, mas não tem permissão.
Include a WWW-Authenticate header. Use 4.fr: Incluez un en-tête WWW-Authenticate. Utilisez 403 quand l'utilisateur est connu mais n'a pas l'autorisation.
Include a WWW-Authenticate header. Use 4.de: Fügen Sie einen WWW-Authenticate-Header hinzu. Verwenden Sie 403, wenn der Benutzer bekannt, aber nicht berechtigt ist.
Include a WWW-Authenticate header. Use 4.id: Sertakan header WWW-Authenticate. Gunakan 403 ketika pengguna dikenal tetapi tidak diizinkan.
Include a WWW-Authenticate header. Use 4.it: Includi un'intestazione WWW-Authenticate. Usa 403 quando l'utente è noto ma non ha il permesso.
Include a WWW-Authenticate header. Use 4.tr: Bir WWW-Authenticate başlığı ekleyin. Kullanıcı biliniyor ama izni yoksa 403 kullanın.
Include a WWW-Authenticate header. Use 4.vi: Kèm header WWW-Authenticate. Dùng 403 khi người dùng đã được biết nhưng không có quyền.
Include a WWW-Authenticate header. Use 4.ru: Добавьте заголовок WWW-Authenticate. Используйте 403, когда пользователь известен, но ему не разрешено.
Include a WWW-Authenticate header. Use 4.hi: WWW-Authenticate हेडर शामिल करें। यूज़र की पहचान हो चुकी हो पर अनुमति न हो, तो 403 इस्तेमाल करें।
Include a WWW-Authenticate header. Use 4.pl: Dołącz nagłówek WWW-Authenticate. Użyj 403, gdy użytkownik jest znany, ale nie ma uprawnień.

Reserved for future use; some services u.es: Reservado para uso futuro; algunos servicios lo usan para indicar que se requiere un pago.
Reserved for future use; some services u.pt-BR: Reservado para uso futuro; alguns serviços o usam para indicar que é preciso pagar.
Reserved for future use; some services u.fr: Réservé à un usage futur ; certains services l'utilisent pour indiquer qu'un paiement est nécessaire.
Reserved for future use; some services u.de: Für die zukünftige Verwendung reserviert; manche Dienste verwenden ihn, um auszudrücken, dass eine Zahlung nötig ist.
Reserved for future use; some services u.id: Dicadangkan untuk penggunaan di masa depan; beberapa layanan menggunakannya untuk menyatakan pembayaran diperlukan.
Reserved for future use; some services u.it: Riservato per uso futuro; alcuni servizi lo usano per indicare che è necessario un pagamento.
Reserved for future use; some services u.tr: Gelecekte kullanılmak üzere ayrılmış; bazı hizmetler ödeme gerektiği anlamında kullanır.
Reserved for future use; some services u.vi: Dành riêng cho tương lai; một số dịch vụ dùng để nghĩa là cần thanh toán.
Reserved for future use; some services u.ru: Зарезервирован для будущего использования; некоторые сервисы используют его, чтобы показать, что нужна оплата.
Reserved for future use; some services u.hi: भविष्य के उपयोग के लिए आरक्षित; कुछ सेवाएँ इसका मतलब "भुगतान चाहिए" लेती हैं।
Reserved for future use; some services u.pl: Zarezerwowany do przyszłego użytku; niektóre usługi używają go na znak, że wymagana jest płatność.

Rarely: a few APIs and platforms return.es: Raramente: algunas API y plataformas lo devuelven por problemas de facturación o de cuota.
Rarely: a few APIs and platforms return.pt-BR: Raramente: algumas APIs e plataformas o retornam em problemas de cobrança ou de cota.
Rarely: a few APIs and platforms return.fr: Rarement : quelques API et plateformes le renvoient pour des problèmes de facturation ou de quota.
Rarely: a few APIs and platforms return.de: Selten: einige APIs und Plattformen geben ihn bei Abrechnungs- oder Kontingentproblemen zurück.
Rarely: a few APIs and platforms return.id: Jarang: beberapa API dan platform mengembalikannya untuk masalah penagihan atau kuota.
Rarely: a few APIs and platforms return.it: Raramente: alcune API e piattaforme lo restituiscono per problemi di fatturazione o di quota.
Rarely: a few APIs and platforms return.tr: Nadiren: birkaç API ve platform bunu faturalama veya kota sorunları için döndürür.
Rarely: a few APIs and platforms return.vi: Hiếm: một vài API và nền tảng trả về mã này cho vấn đề thanh toán hoặc hạn mức.
Rarely: a few APIs and platforms return.ru: Редко: некоторые API и платформы возвращают его при проблемах с оплатой или квотой.
Rarely: a few APIs and platforms return.hi: कभी-कभी: कुछ API और प्लेटफ़ॉर्म इसे बिलिंग या कोटा की समस्याओं के लिए लौटाते हैं।
Rarely: a few APIs and platforms return.pl: Rzadko: kilka API i platform zwraca go przy problemach z rozliczeniami lub limitem.

Check the service's documentation for wh.es: Consulta la documentación del servicio para saber qué significa allí.
Check the service's documentation for wh.pt-BR: Consulte a documentação do serviço para saber o que ele significa ali.
Check the service's documentation for wh.fr: Consultez la documentation du service pour savoir ce qu'il signifie dans ce contexte.
Check the service's documentation for wh.de: Lesen Sie in der Dokumentation des Dienstes nach, was er dort bedeutet.
Check the service's documentation for wh.id: Periksa dokumentasi layanan untuk mengetahui artinya di sana.
Check the service's documentation for wh.it: Consulta la documentazione del servizio per capire cosa significa lì.
Check the service's documentation for wh.tr: Hizmetin belgelerinde burada ne anlama geldiğine bakın.
Check the service's documentation for wh.vi: Xem tài liệu của dịch vụ để biết ý nghĩa ở đó.
Check the service's documentation for wh.ru: Посмотрите в документации сервиса, что он там означает.
Check the service's documentation for wh.hi: देखें कि उस सेवा के डॉक्यूमेंटेशन में इसका क्या मतलब है।
Check the service's documentation for wh.pl: Sprawdź w dokumentacji usługi, co oznacza w jej przypadku.

Use a clear body that explains the billi.es: Usa un cuerpo claro que explique el problema de facturación, ya que el estándar no le da un significado fijo.
Use a clear body that explains the billi.pt-BR: Use um corpo claro que explique o problema de cobrança, já que o padrão não lhe dá um significado fixo.
Use a clear body that explains the billi.fr: Utilisez un corps clair qui explique le problème de facturation, car la norme ne lui donne aucune signification fixe.
Use a clear body that explains the billi.de: Verwenden Sie einen klaren Body, der das Abrechnungsproblem erklärt, da der Standard ihm keine feste Bedeutung zuweist.
Use a clear body that explains the billi.id: Gunakan body yang jelas yang menjelaskan masalah penagihan, karena standar tidak memberinya makna tetap.
Use a clear body that explains the billi.it: Usa un corpo chiaro che spieghi il problema di fatturazione, dato che lo standard non gli assegna un significato fisso.
Use a clear body that explains the billi.tr: Standart sabit bir anlam vermediği için faturalama sorununu açıklayan net bir gövde kullanın.
Use a clear body that explains the billi.vi: Dùng body rõ ràng giải thích vấn đề thanh toán, vì tiêu chuẩn không quy định ý nghĩa cố định.
Use a clear body that explains the billi.ru: Используйте понятное тело, объясняющее проблему с оплатой, так как стандарт не придаёт ему фиксированного значения.
Use a clear body that explains the billi.hi: बिलिंग की समस्या समझाने वाली साफ़ बॉडी इस्तेमाल करें, क्योंकि मानक इसे कोई तय मतलब नहीं देता।
Use a clear body that explains the billi.pl: Użyj czytelnej treści wyjaśniającej problem z rozliczeniami, ponieważ standard nie nadaje mu stałego znaczenia.

The server understood the request and re.es: El servidor entendió la solicitud y se niega a permitirla, incluso con credenciales.
The server understood the request and re.pt-BR: O servidor entendeu a requisição e se recusa a permiti-la, mesmo com credenciais.
The server understood the request and re.fr: Le serveur a compris la requête et refuse de l'autoriser, même avec des identifiants.
The server understood the request and re.de: Der Server hat die Anfrage verstanden und verweigert die Ausführung, auch mit Zugangsdaten.
The server understood the request and re.id: Server memahami permintaan dan menolak mengizinkannya, bahkan dengan kredensial.
The server understood the request and re.it: Il server ha compreso la richiesta e si rifiuta di consentirla, anche con le credenziali.
The server understood the request and re.tr: Sunucu isteği anladı ve kimlik bilgileriyle bile olsa izin vermeyi reddediyor.
The server understood the request and re.vi: Máy chủ hiểu yêu cầu và từ chối cho phép, kể cả khi có thông tin xác thực.
The server understood the request and re.ru: Сервер понял запрос и отказывается его выполнять, даже с учётными данными.
The server understood the request and re.hi: सर्वर ने रिक्वेस्ट समझ ली है और क्रेडेंशियल होने पर भी उसकी अनुमति देने से मना करता है।
The server understood the request and re.pl: Serwer zrozumiał żądanie i odmawia jego wykonania, nawet z danymi uwierzytelniającymi.

Missing permission, blocked IP address o.es: Falta de permisos, una dirección IP o un país bloqueado, una regla de CORS o de WAF, o un directorio sin índice.
Missing permission, blocked IP address o.pt-BR: Falta de permissão, endereço IP ou país bloqueado, uma regra de CORS ou de WAF, ou um diretório sem index.
Missing permission, blocked IP address o.fr: Permission manquante, adresse IP ou pays bloqué, règle CORS ou WAF, ou répertoire sans fichier index.
Missing permission, blocked IP address o.de: Fehlende Berechtigung, gesperrte IP-Adresse oder gesperrtes Land, eine CORS- oder WAF-Regel oder ein Verzeichnis ohne Index.
Missing permission, blocked IP address o.id: Izin yang kurang, alamat IP atau negara yang diblokir, aturan CORS atau WAF, atau direktori tanpa index.
Missing permission, blocked IP address o.it: Permesso mancante, indirizzo IP o paese bloccato, una regola CORS o WAF, oppure una directory senza index.
Missing permission, blocked IP address o.tr: Eksik izin, engellenmiş IP adresi veya ülke, bir CORS ya da WAF kuralı veya dizin sayfası olmayan bir dizin.
Missing permission, blocked IP address o.vi: Thiếu quyền, địa chỉ IP hoặc quốc gia bị chặn, quy tắc CORS hoặc WAF, hoặc thư mục không có tệp index.
Missing permission, blocked IP address o.ru: Нет разрешения, заблокированы IP-адрес или страна, сработало правило CORS или WAF либо каталог без индекса.
Missing permission, blocked IP address o.hi: अनुमति न होना, ब्लॉक किया गया IP पता या देश, CORS या WAF नियम, या बिना इंडेक्स वाली डायरेक्टरी।
Missing permission, blocked IP address o.pl: Brak uprawnienia, zablokowany adres IP lub kraj, reguła CORS lub WAF albo katalog bez pliku index.

Do not retry unchanged. Check your permi.es: No reintentes sin cambios. Revisa tus permisos, tu rol y las reglas de firewall.
Do not retry unchanged. Check your permi.pt-BR: Não tente de novo sem alterações. Verifique suas permissões, seu papel e as regras de firewall.
Do not retry unchanged. Check your permi.fr: Ne réessayez pas sans changement. Vérifiez vos permissions, votre rôle et les éventuelles règles de pare-feu.
Do not retry unchanged. Check your permi.de: Wiederholen Sie die Anfrage nicht unverändert. Prüfen Sie Ihre Berechtigungen, Ihre Rolle und eventuelle Firewall-Regeln.
Do not retry unchanged. Check your permi.id: Jangan ulangi tanpa perubahan. Periksa izin, role, dan aturan firewall Anda.
Do not retry unchanged. Check your permi.it: Non riprovare senza modifiche. Controlla i tuoi permessi, il tuo ruolo e le eventuali regole del firewall.
Do not retry unchanged. Check your permi.tr: Değiştirmeden yeniden denemeyin. İzinlerinizi, rolünüzü ve güvenlik duvarı kurallarını kontrol edin.
Do not retry unchanged. Check your permi.vi: Đừng thử lại nguyên trạng. Kiểm tra quyền, vai trò và các quy tắc tường lửa.
Do not retry unchanged. Check your permi.ru: Не повторяйте без изменений. Проверьте свои разрешения, роль и правила межсетевого экрана.
Do not retry unchanged. Check your permi.hi: बिना बदलाव दोबारा कोशिश न करें। अपनी अनुमतियाँ, रोल और फ़ायरवॉल नियम जाँचें।
Do not retry unchanged. Check your permi.pl: Nie ponawiaj bez zmian. Sprawdź swoje uprawnienia, rolę i ewentualne reguły zapory.

Use for known users who may not do this..es: Úsalo para usuarios conocidos que no pueden hacer esto. Algunos sitios devuelven 404 para ocultar que el recurso existe.
Use for known users who may not do this..pt-BR: Use para usuários conhecidos que não podem fazer isso. Alguns sites retornam 404 para esconder que o recurso existe.
Use for known users who may not do this..fr: À utiliser pour les utilisateurs connus qui n'ont pas le droit de faire cela. Certains sites renvoient plutôt 404 pour masquer l'existence d'une ressource.
Use for known users who may not do this..de: Verwenden Sie ihn für bekannte Benutzer, die dies nicht tun dürfen. Manche Websites geben stattdessen 404 zurück, um zu verbergen, dass eine Ressource existiert.
Use for known users who may not do this..id: Gunakan untuk pengguna yang dikenal tetapi tidak boleh melakukan ini. Beberapa situs mengembalikan 404 untuk menyembunyikan keberadaan sumber daya.
Use for known users who may not do this..it: Usalo per utenti noti che non possono eseguire questa azione. Alcuni siti restituiscono invece 404 per nascondere l'esistenza di una risorsa.
Use for known users who may not do this..tr: Bunu yapmasına izin verilmeyen bilinen kullanıcılar için kullanın. Bazı siteler bir kaynağın varlığını gizlemek için bunun yerine 404 döndürür.
Use for known users who may not do this..vi: Dùng cho người dùng đã biết nhưng không được phép làm việc này. Một số trang trả về 404 để giấu việc tài nguyên có tồn tại.
Use for known users who may not do this..ru: Используйте для известных пользователей, которым это запрещено. Некоторые сайты возвращают вместо него 404, чтобы скрыть существование ресурса.
Use for known users who may not do this..hi: उन जाने-पहचाने यूज़र के लिए इस्तेमाल करें जिन्हें यह करने की अनुमति नहीं है। कुछ साइटें संसाधन के होने की बात छिपाने के लिए इसकी जगह 404 लौटाती हैं।
Use for known users who may not do this..pl: Używaj dla znanych użytkowników, którzy nie mogą tego zrobić. Niektóre strony zwracają zamiast tego 404, aby ukryć istnienie zasobu.

The server cannot find the requested res.es: El servidor no puede encontrar el recurso solicitado.
The server cannot find the requested res.pt-BR: O servidor não consegue encontrar o recurso solicitado.
The server cannot find the requested res.fr: Le serveur ne trouve pas la ressource demandée.
The server cannot find the requested res.de: Der Server kann die angeforderte Ressource nicht finden.
The server cannot find the requested res.id: Server tidak dapat menemukan sumber daya yang diminta.
The server cannot find the requested res.it: Il server non riesce a trovare la risorsa richiesta.
The server cannot find the requested res.vi: Máy chủ không tìm thấy tài nguyên được yêu cầu.
The server cannot find the requested res.ru: Сервер не может найти запрошенный ресурс.
The server cannot find the requested res.hi: सर्वर को माँगा गया संसाधन नहीं मिला।
The server cannot find the requested res.pl: Serwer nie może znaleźć żądanego zasobu.

A mistyped or deleted URL, a broken link.es: Una URL mal escrita o eliminada, un enlace roto o una ruta que no existe.
A mistyped or deleted URL, a broken link.pt-BR: Uma URL digitada errada ou excluída, um link quebrado ou uma rota que não existe.
A mistyped or deleted URL, a broken link.fr: URL mal saisie ou supprimée, lien cassé, ou route inexistante.
A mistyped or deleted URL, a broken link.de: Eine falsch geschriebene oder gelöschte URL, ein defekter Link oder eine nicht vorhandene Route.
A mistyped or deleted URL, a broken link.id: URL yang salah ketik atau dihapus, tautan rusak, atau route yang tidak ada.
A mistyped or deleted URL, a broken link.it: Un URL scritto male o eliminato, un link interrotto o un percorso che non esiste.
A mistyped or deleted URL, a broken link.tr: Yanlış yazılmış veya silinmiş bir URL, kırık bir bağlantı ya da var olmayan bir yol.
A mistyped or deleted URL, a broken link.vi: URL gõ sai hoặc đã bị xóa, liên kết hỏng, hoặc route không tồn tại.
A mistyped or deleted URL, a broken link.ru: URL с опечаткой или удалённый, неработающая ссылка либо несуществующий маршрут.
A mistyped or deleted URL, a broken link.hi: ग़लत टाइप किया या हटाया गया URL, टूटा हुआ लिंक, या ऐसा रूट जो मौजूद नहीं है।
A mistyped or deleted URL, a broken link.pl: Błędnie wpisany lub usunięty adres URL, zepsuty link albo trasa, która nie istnieje.

Check the URL for typos. If the link cam.es: Revisa que la URL no tenga errores de escritura. Si el enlace venía de una página, avisa a su responsable.
Check the URL for typos. If the link cam.pt-BR: Verifique se a URL tem erros de digitação. Se o link veio de uma página, avise o responsável por ela.
Check the URL for typos. If the link cam.fr: Vérifiez l'URL pour y repérer des fautes de frappe. Si le lien provient d'une page, prévenez son propriétaire.
Check the URL for typos. If the link cam.de: Prüfen Sie die URL auf Tippfehler. Stammt der Link von einer Seite, informieren Sie deren Betreiber.
Check the URL for typos. If the link cam.id: Periksa apakah ada salah ketik di URL. Jika tautan berasal dari sebuah halaman, beri tahu pemiliknya.
Check the URL for typos. If the link cam.it: Controlla che l'URL non contenga errori di battitura. Se il link proviene da una pagina, avvisa il suo proprietario.
Check the URL for typos. If the link cam.tr: URL'de yazım hataları olup olmadığına bakın. Bağlantı bir sayfadan geldiyse sayfanın sahibine bildirin.
Check the URL for typos. If the link cam.vi: Kiểm tra URL xem có gõ sai không. Nếu liên kết đến từ một trang, hãy báo cho chủ trang đó.
Check the URL for typos. If the link cam.ru: Проверьте URL на опечатки. Если ссылка была на странице, сообщите её владельцу.
Check the URL for typos. If the link cam.hi: URL में टाइपो जाँचें। अगर लिंक किसी पेज से आया था, तो उसके मालिक को बताएँ।
Check the URL for typos. If the link cam.pl: Sprawdź adres URL pod kątem literówek. Jeśli link pochodzi ze strony, powiadom jej właściciela.

Return it for missing pages, with a help.es: Devuélvelo para páginas inexistentes, con una página útil. Usa 410 si una página desapareció para siempre, y corrige los enlaces internos rotos.
Return it for missing pages, with a help.pt-BR: Retorne-o para páginas inexistentes, com uma página útil. Use 410 se uma página sumiu de vez, e corrija os links internos quebrados.
Return it for missing pages, with a help.fr: Renvoyez-le pour les pages manquantes, avec une page utile. Utilisez 410 si une page a disparu définitivement, et corrigez les liens internes cassés.
Return it for missing pages, with a help.de: Geben Sie ihn für fehlende Seiten zurück, mit einer hilfreichen Seite. Verwenden Sie 410, wenn eine Seite endgültig entfernt wurde, und beheben Sie defekte interne Links.
Return it for missing pages, with a help.id: Kembalikan untuk halaman yang hilang, dengan halaman yang membantu. Gunakan 410 jika halaman hilang selamanya, dan perbaiki tautan internal yang rusak.
Return it for missing pages, with a help.it: Restituiscilo per le pagine mancanti, con una pagina utile. Usa 410 se una pagina è sparita per sempre e correggi i link interni interrotti.
Return it for missing pages, with a help.tr: Eksik sayfalar için yararlı bir sayfayla birlikte döndürün. Bir sayfa kalıcı olarak kalktıysa 410 kullanın ve kırık iç bağlantıları düzeltin.
Return it for missing pages, with a help.vi: Trả về cho các trang không tồn tại, kèm một trang hữu ích. Dùng 410 nếu trang đã mất vĩnh viễn, và sửa các liên kết nội bộ bị hỏng.
Return it for missing pages, with a help.ru: Возвращайте его для отсутствующих страниц, показывая полезную страницу. Если страница удалена навсегда, используйте 410, и исправьте неработающие внутренние ссылки.
Return it for missing pages, with a help.hi: ग़ायब पेजों के लिए इसे काम के पेज के साथ लौटाएँ। अगर पेज हमेशा के लिए चला गया है तो 410 इस्तेमाल करें, और टूटे आंतरिक लिंक ठीक करें।
Return it for missing pages, with a help.pl: Zwracaj go dla brakujących stron, razem z pomocną stroną. Użyj 410, jeśli strona zniknęła na dobre, i napraw zepsute linki wewnętrzne.

The URL exists, but it does not support.es: La URL existe, pero no admite el método HTTP utilizado.
The URL exists, but it does not support.pt-BR: A URL existe, mas não suporta o método HTTP usado.
The URL exists, but it does not support.fr: L'URL existe, mais elle ne prend pas en charge la méthode HTTP utilisée.
The URL exists, but it does not support.de: Die URL existiert, unterstützt aber die verwendete HTTP-Methode nicht.
The URL exists, but it does not support.id: URL tersebut ada, tetapi tidak mendukung method HTTP yang digunakan.
The URL exists, but it does not support.it: L'URL esiste, ma non supporta il metodo HTTP utilizzato.
The URL exists, but it does not support.tr: URL var ama kullanılan HTTP yöntemini desteklemiyor.
The URL exists, but it does not support.vi: URL tồn tại, nhưng không hỗ trợ phương thức HTTP đã dùng.
The URL exists, but it does not support.ru: URL существует, но не поддерживает использованный метод HTTP.
The URL exists, but it does not support.hi: URL मौजूद है, लेकिन वह इस्तेमाल किए गए HTTP मेथड को सपोर्ट नहीं करता।
The URL exists, but it does not support.pl: Adres URL istnieje, ale nie obsługuje użytej metody HTTP.

A POST to a read-only endpoint, or a GET.es: Un POST a un endpoint de solo lectura, o un GET a un manejador de formularios.
A POST to a read-only endpoint, or a GET.pt-BR: Um POST para um endpoint somente leitura ou um GET para um tratador de formulário.
A POST to a read-only endpoint, or a GET.fr: Un POST vers un point d'accès en lecture seule, ou un GET vers un gestionnaire de formulaire.
A POST to a read-only endpoint, or a GET.de: Ein POST an einen schreibgeschützten Endpunkt oder ein GET an einen Formular-Handler.
A POST to a read-only endpoint, or a GET.id: POST ke endpoint read-only, atau GET ke handler formulir.
A POST to a read-only endpoint, or a GET.it: Un POST a un endpoint di sola lettura, o un GET a un gestore di moduli.
A POST to a read-only endpoint, or a GET.tr: Salt okunur bir uç noktaya POST veya bir form işleyiciye GET.
A POST to a read-only endpoint, or a GET.vi: Một POST đến endpoint chỉ đọc, hoặc một GET đến trình xử lý biểu mẫu.
A POST to a read-only endpoint, or a GET.ru: POST на конечную точку только для чтения или GET на обработчик формы.
A POST to a read-only endpoint, or a GET.hi: केवल-पढ़ने वाले एंडपॉइंट पर POST, या फ़ॉर्म हैंडलर पर GET।
A POST to a read-only endpoint, or a GET.pl: POST do punktu końcowego tylko do odczytu albo GET do obsługi formularza.

Read the Allow header to see which metho.es: Lee el encabezado Allow para ver qué métodos funcionan.
Read the Allow header to see which metho.pt-BR: Leia o cabeçalho Allow para ver quais métodos funcionam.
Read the Allow header to see which metho.fr: Lisez l'en-tête Allow pour savoir quelles méthodes fonctionnent.
Read the Allow header to see which metho.de: Lesen Sie den Allow-Header, um zu sehen, welche Methoden funktionieren.
Read the Allow header to see which metho.id: Baca header Allow untuk melihat method mana yang berfungsi.
Read the Allow header to see which metho.it: Leggi l'intestazione Allow per vedere quali metodi funzionano.
Read the Allow header to see which metho.tr: Hangi yöntemlerin çalıştığını görmek için Allow başlığını okuyun.
Read the Allow header to see which metho.vi: Đọc header Allow để biết phương thức nào dùng được.
Read the Allow header to see which metho.ru: Прочитайте заголовок Allow, чтобы узнать, какие методы работают.
Read the Allow header to see which metho.hi: कौन-से मेथड चलते हैं, यह देखने के लिए Allow हेडर पढ़ें।
Read the Allow header to see which metho.pl: Odczytaj nagłówek Allow, aby zobaczyć, które metody działają.

Send the Allow header. Check your route.es: Envía el encabezado Allow. Revisa la definición de tus rutas y cualquier proxy que bloquee métodos.
Send the Allow header. Check your route.pt-BR: Envie o cabeçalho Allow. Verifique as definições de rota e qualquer proxy que bloqueie métodos.
Send the Allow header. Check your route.fr: Envoyez l'en-tête Allow. Vérifiez vos définitions de routes et tout proxy qui bloque des méthodes.
Send the Allow header. Check your route.de: Senden Sie den Allow-Header. Prüfen Sie Ihre Routendefinitionen und jeden Proxy, der Methoden blockiert.
Send the Allow header. Check your route.id: Kirim header Allow. Periksa definisi route Anda dan proxy mana pun yang memblokir method.
Send the Allow header. Check your route.it: Invia l'intestazione Allow. Controlla le definizioni dei percorsi e gli eventuali proxy che bloccano dei metodi.
Send the Allow header. Check your route.tr: Allow başlığını gönderin. Yol tanımlarınızı ve yöntemleri engelleyen vekil sunucuları kontrol edin.
Send the Allow header. Check your route.vi: Gửi header Allow. Kiểm tra định nghĩa route và mọi proxy chặn phương thức.
Send the Allow header. Check your route.ru: Отправляйте заголовок Allow. Проверьте определения маршрутов и прокси, блокирующие методы.
Send the Allow header. Check your route.hi: Allow हेडर भेजें। अपनी रूट परिभाषाएँ और मेथड ब्लॉक करने वाली किसी भी प्रॉक्सी को जाँचें।
Send the Allow header. Check your route.pl: Wysyłaj nagłówek Allow. Sprawdź definicje tras i serwer proxy, który blokuje metody.

The server cannot produce a response tha.es: El servidor no puede producir una respuesta que coincida con los encabezados Accept del cliente.
The server cannot produce a response tha.pt-BR: O servidor não consegue produzir uma resposta que corresponda aos cabeçalhos Accept do cliente.
The server cannot produce a response tha.fr: Le serveur ne peut pas produire de réponse correspondant aux en-têtes Accept du client.
The server cannot produce a response tha.de: Der Server kann keine Antwort erzeugen, die zu den Accept-Headern des Clients passt.
The server cannot produce a response tha.id: Server tidak dapat menghasilkan respons yang sesuai dengan header Accept klien.
The server cannot produce a response tha.it: Il server non riesce a produrre una risposta che corrisponda alle intestazioni Accept del client.
The server cannot produce a response tha.tr: Sunucu, istemcinin Accept başlıklarına uyan bir yanıt üretemiyor.
The server cannot produce a response tha.vi: Máy chủ không thể tạo phản hồi khớp với các header Accept của máy khách.
The server cannot produce a response tha.ru: Сервер не может сформировать ответ, подходящий под заголовки Accept клиента.
The server cannot produce a response tha.hi: सर्वर क्लाइंट के Accept हेडर से मेल खाता जवाब नहीं बना सकता।
The server cannot produce a response tha.pl: Serwer nie może wygenerować odpowiedzi pasującej do nagłówków Accept klienta.

A request for a format or language the s.es: Una solicitud de un formato o idioma que el servidor no ofrece.
A request for a format or language the s.pt-BR: Uma requisição por um formato ou idioma que o servidor não oferece.
A request for a format or language the s.fr: Une requête pour un format ou une langue que le serveur ne propose pas.
A request for a format or language the s.de: Eine Anfrage nach einem Format oder einer Sprache, die der Server nicht anbietet.
A request for a format or language the s.id: Permintaan format atau bahasa yang tidak disediakan server.
A request for a format or language the s.it: Una richiesta di un formato o di una lingua che il server non offre.
A request for a format or language the s.tr: Sunucunun sunmadığı bir biçim veya dil için yapılan istek.
A request for a format or language the s.vi: Yêu cầu một định dạng hoặc ngôn ngữ mà máy chủ không cung cấp.
A request for a format or language the s.ru: Запрос формата или языка, которого сервер не предлагает.
A request for a format or language the s.hi: ऐसे फ़ॉर्मैट या भाषा की माँग जो सर्वर नहीं देता।
A request for a format or language the s.pl: Żądanie formatu lub języka, których serwer nie oferuje.

Loosen your Accept headers or ask for a.es: Flexibiliza tus encabezados Accept o pide un tipo compatible.
Loosen your Accept headers or ask for a.pt-BR: Flexibilize seus cabeçalhos Accept ou peça um tipo suportado.
Loosen your Accept headers or ask for a.fr: Assouplissez vos en-têtes Accept ou demandez un type pris en charge.
Loosen your Accept headers or ask for a.de: Lockern Sie Ihre Accept-Header oder fordern Sie einen unterstützten Typ an.
Loosen your Accept headers or ask for a.id: Longgarkan header Accept Anda atau minta tipe yang didukung.
Loosen your Accept headers or ask for a.it: Allenta le intestazioni Accept oppure chiedi un tipo supportato.
Loosen your Accept headers or ask for a.tr: Accept başlıklarınızı gevşetin veya desteklenen bir tür isteyin.
Loosen your Accept headers or ask for a.vi: Nới lỏng các header Accept hoặc yêu cầu một loại được hỗ trợ.
Loosen your Accept headers or ask for a.ru: Ослабьте заголовки Accept или запросите поддерживаемый тип.
Loosen your Accept headers or ask for a.hi: अपने Accept हेडर ढीले करें या सपोर्टेड टाइप माँगें।
Loosen your Accept headers or ask for a.pl: Poluzuj nagłówki Accept albo poproś o obsługiwany typ.

Often better to return your default form.es: Suele ser mejor devolver tu formato predeterminado que un 406.
Often better to return your default form.pt-BR: Muitas vezes é melhor retornar seu formato padrão do que um 406.
Often better to return your default form.fr: Il vaut souvent mieux renvoyer votre format par défaut qu'un 406.
Often better to return your default form.de: Oft ist es besser, Ihr Standardformat zurückzugeben als ein 406.
Often better to return your default form.id: Sering kali lebih baik mengembalikan format default Anda daripada 406.
Often better to return your default form.it: Spesso è meglio restituire il formato predefinito che un 406.
Often better to return your default form.tr: Çoğu zaman 406 yerine varsayılan biçiminizi döndürmek daha iyidir.
Often better to return your default form.vi: Thường nên trả về định dạng mặc định hơn là 406.
Often better to return your default form.ru: Часто лучше вернуть формат по умолчанию, чем 406.
Often better to return your default form.hi: 406 की जगह अपना डिफ़ॉल्ट फ़ॉर्मैट लौटाना अक्सर बेहतर होता है।
Often better to return your default form.pl: Często lepiej zwrócić domyślny format niż 406.

Like 401, but the client must authentica.es: Como el 401, pero el cliente debe autenticarse primero con el proxy.
Like 401, but the client must authentica.pt-BR: Como o 401, mas o cliente precisa se autenticar primeiro no proxy.
Like 401, but the client must authentica.fr: Comme 401, mais le client doit d'abord s'authentifier auprès du proxy.
Like 401, but the client must authentica.de: Wie 401, aber der Client muss sich zuerst beim Proxy authentifizieren.
Like 401, but the client must authentica.id: Seperti 401, tetapi klien harus mengautentikasi diri ke proxy terlebih dahulu.
Like 401, but the client must authentica.it: Come 401, ma il client deve prima autenticarsi presso il proxy.
Like 401, but the client must authentica.tr: 401 gibi, ancak istemcinin önce vekil sunucuda kimlik doğrulaması yapması gerekir.
Like 401, but the client must authentica.vi: Giống 401, nhưng máy khách phải xác thực với proxy trước.
Like 401, but the client must authentica.ru: Как 401, но клиент сначала должен аутентифицироваться на прокси.
Like 401, but the client must authentica.hi: 401 जैसा, लेकिन क्लाइंट को पहले प्रॉक्सी से ऑथेंटिकेट करना होगा।
Like 401, but the client must authentica.pl: Jak 401, ale klient musi najpierw uwierzytelnić się w serwerze proxy.

Corporate proxies that need credentials..fr: Proxys d'entreprise qui exigent des identifiants.

Uploads sent with chunked encoding to a.tr: Bunu kabul etmeyen bir sunucuya chunked kodlamayla gönderilen yüklemeler.

Uploads sent with chunked encoding to a.ru: Загрузки с chunked-кодированием на сервер, который его не принимает.
Uploads sent with chunked encoding to a.hi: चंक्ड एन्कोडिंग से भेजे गए अपलोड, ऐसे सर्वर पर जो उसे स्वीकार नहीं करता।
Uploads sent with chunked encoding to a.pl: Pliki przesyłane z kodowaniem chunked do serwera, który go nie akceptuje.

Accept chunked bodies if your clients ne.es: Acepta cuerpos chunked si tus clientes los necesitan.
Accept chunked bodies if your clients ne.pt-BR: Aceite corpos chunked se seus clientes precisarem deles.
Accept chunked bodies if your clients ne.fr: Acceptez les corps chunked si vos clients en ont besoin.

Accept chunked bodies if your clients ne.it: Accetta corpi chunked se i tuoi client ne hanno bisogno.

Accept chunked bodies if your clients ne.vi: Chấp nhận body chunked nếu máy khách của bạn cần.
Accept chunked bodies if your clients ne.ru: Принимайте chunked-тела, если они нужны вашим клиентам.

A condition in the request headers, such.es: Una condición en los encabezados de la solicitud, como If-Match, no se cumplió en el servidor.
A condition in the request headers, such.pt-BR: Uma condição nos cabeçalhos da requisição, como If-Match, não era verdadeira no servidor.
A condition in the request headers, such.fr: Une condition des en-têtes de la requête, comme If-Match, était fausse sur le serveur.
A condition in the request headers, such.de: Eine Bedingung in den Request-Headern, etwa If-Match, war auf dem Server nicht erfüllt.
A condition in the request headers, such.id: Suatu kondisi pada header permintaan, seperti If-Match, tidak terpenuhi di server.

A condition in the request headers, such.vi: Một điều kiện trong header của yêu cầu, chẳng hạn If-Match, không đúng trên máy chủ.
A condition in the request headers, such.ru: Условие в заголовках запроса, например If-Match, на сервере не выполнилось.
A condition in the request headers, such.hi: रिक्वेस्ट हेडर की कोई शर्त, जैसे If-Match, सर्वर पर सही नहीं निकली।
A condition in the request headers, such.pl: Warunek w nagłówkach żądania, na przykład If-Match, nie był prawdziwy na serwerze.

Updates that use ETags to avoid overwrit.es: Actualizaciones que usan ETags para evitar sobrescribir el cambio de otra persona.
Updates that use ETags to avoid overwrit.pt-BR: Atualizações que usam ETags para evitar sobrescrever a alteração de outra pessoa.
Updates that use ETags to avoid overwrit.fr: Mises à jour qui utilisent des ETags pour éviter d'écraser la modification de quelqu'un d'autre.
Updates that use ETags to avoid overwrit.de: Änderungen, die ETags verwenden, um die Änderung eines anderen nicht zu überschreiben.
Updates that use ETags to avoid overwrit.id: Pembaruan yang menggunakan ETag untuk menghindari menimpa perubahan orang lain.
Updates that use ETags to avoid overwrit.it: Aggiornamenti che usano gli ETag per evitare di sovrascrivere la modifica di qualcun altro.
Updates that use ETags to avoid overwrit.tr: Başkasının değişikliğinin üzerine yazmamak için ETag kullanan güncellemeler.
Updates that use ETags to avoid overwrit.vi: Các bản cập nhật dùng ETag để tránh ghi đè thay đổi của người khác.
Updates that use ETags to avoid overwrit.ru: Обновления с ETag, чтобы не перезаписать чужое изменение.
Updates that use ETags to avoid overwrit.hi: वे अपडेट जो किसी और का बदलाव मिटने से बचाने के लिए ETag इस्तेमाल करते हैं।
Updates that use ETags to avoid overwrit.pl: Aktualizacje używające ETag, aby uniknąć nadpisania cudzej zmiany.

Reload the resource, redo your change on.es: Vuelve a cargar el recurso, rehaz tu cambio sobre la última versión y envíalo de nuevo.
Reload the resource, redo your change on.pt-BR: Recarregue o recurso, refaça sua alteração na versão mais recente e envie de novo.
Reload the resource, redo your change on.fr: Rechargez la ressource, refaites votre modification sur la dernière version et renvoyez-la.
Reload the resource, redo your change on.de: Laden Sie die Ressource neu, wiederholen Sie Ihre Änderung auf der neuesten Version und senden Sie sie erneut.
Reload the resource, redo your change on.id: Muat ulang sumber daya, ulangi perubahan Anda pada versi terbaru, lalu kirim lagi.
Reload the resource, redo your change on.it: Ricarica la risorsa, rifai la modifica sull'ultima versione e inviala di nuovo.
Reload the resource, redo your change on.tr: Kaynağı yeniden yükleyin, değişikliğinizi en son sürümde yeniden yapın ve tekrar gönderin.
Reload the resource, redo your change on.vi: Tải lại tài nguyên, làm lại thay đổi của bạn trên phiên bản mới nhất rồi gửi lại.
Reload the resource, redo your change on.ru: Перезагрузите ресурс, повторите свою правку на последней версии и отправьте снова.
Reload the resource, redo your change on.hi: संसाधन दोबारा लोड करें, अपना बदलाव ताज़ा संस्करण पर दोबारा करें और फिर भेजें।
Reload the resource, redo your change on.pl: Wczytaj zasób ponownie, powtórz zmianę na najnowszej wersji i wyślij ją jeszcze raz.

Return it when If-Match or If-Unmodified.es: Devuélvelo cuando If-Match o If-Unmodified-Since fallen.
Return it when If-Match or If-Unmodified.pt-BR: Retorne-o quando If-Match ou If-Unmodified-Since falhar.
Return it when If-Match or If-Unmodified.fr: Renvoyez-le quand If-Match ou If-Unmodified-Since échoue.
Return it when If-Match or If-Unmodified.de: Geben Sie ihn zurück, wenn If-Match oder If-Unmodified-Since fehlschlägt.

Return it when If-Match or If-Unmodified.tr: If-Match veya If-Unmodified-Since başarısız olduğunda döndürün.
Return it when If-Match or If-Unmodified.vi: Trả về khi If-Match hoặc If-Unmodified-Since thất bại.
Return it when If-Match or If-Unmodified.ru: Возвращайте его, когда If-Match или If-Unmodified-Since не выполняется.

Return it when If-Match or If-Unmodified.pl: Zwracaj go, gdy If-Match lub If-Unmodified-Since się nie powiedzie.

The request body is larger than the serv.pt-BR: O corpo da requisição é maior do que o servidor está disposto a aceitar.
The request body is larger than the serv.fr: Le corps de la requête est plus volumineux que ce que le serveur accepte.
The request body is larger than the serv.de: Der Request-Body ist größer, als der Server zu akzeptieren bereit ist.
The request body is larger than the serv.id: Body permintaan lebih besar daripada yang bersedia diterima server.
The request body is larger than the serv.it: Il corpo della richiesta è più grande di quanto il server sia disposto ad accettare.
The request body is larger than the serv.tr: İstek gövdesi sunucunun kabul etmeye razı olduğundan büyük.

The request body is larger than the serv.hi: रिक्वेस्ट बॉडी उससे बड़ी है जितनी सर्वर स्वीकार करने को तैयार है।
The request body is larger than the serv.pl: Treść żądania jest większa, niż serwer chce zaakceptować.

Uploading a file above a size limit set.es: Subir un archivo que supera el límite de tamaño fijado por un servidor web, proxy o framework. Antes se llamaba Payload Too Large.
Uploading a file above a size limit set.pt-BR: Upload de um arquivo acima do limite de tamanho definido por um servidor web, proxy ou framework. Antes chamado de Payload Too Large.
Uploading a file above a size limit set.fr: Envoi d'un fichier dépassant une limite de taille définie par un serveur web, un proxy ou un framework. Anciennement nommé Payload Too Large.
Uploading a file above a size limit set.de: Der Upload einer Datei über dem Größenlimit, das ein Webserver, Proxy oder Framework setzt. Früher als Payload Too Large bezeichnet.
Uploading a file above a size limit set.id: Mengunggah file di atas batas ukuran yang ditetapkan oleh web server, proxy, atau framework. Sebelumnya bernama Payload Too Large.
Uploading a file above a size limit set.it: Caricamento di un file oltre il limite di dimensione impostato da un web server, un proxy o un framework. In precedenza chiamato Payload Too Large.
Uploading a file above a size limit set.tr: Bir web sunucusu, vekil sunucu veya çerçevenin belirlediği boyut sınırının üzerinde dosya yükleme. Eskiden Payload Too Large olarak adlandırılıyordu.
Uploading a file above a size limit set.vi: Tải lên tệp vượt quá giới hạn dung lượng do máy chủ web, proxy hoặc framework đặt ra. Trước đây có tên Payload Too Large.
Uploading a file above a size limit set.ru: Загрузка файла сверх лимита размера, заданного веб-сервером, прокси или фреймворком. Ранее называлось Payload Too Large.
Uploading a file above a size limit set.hi: वेब सर्वर, प्रॉक्सी या फ़्रेमवर्क की तय की हुई साइज़ सीमा से बड़ी फ़ाइल अपलोड करना। पहले इसका नाम Payload Too Large था।
Uploading a file above a size limit set.pl: Przesyłanie pliku powyżej limitu rozmiaru ustawionego przez serwer WWW, proxy lub framework. Wcześniej nazywany Payload Too Large.

Send a smaller body, or split the upload.es: Envía un cuerpo más pequeño, o divide la subida.
Send a smaller body, or split the upload.pt-BR: Envie um corpo menor ou divida o upload.
Send a smaller body, or split the upload.fr: Envoyez un corps plus petit, ou découpez l'envoi.
Send a smaller body, or split the upload.de: Senden Sie einen kleineren Body oder teilen Sie den Upload auf.
Send a smaller body, or split the upload.id: Kirim body yang lebih kecil, atau pecah unggahannya.
Send a smaller body, or split the upload.it: Invia un corpo più piccolo, oppure suddividi l'upload.
Send a smaller body, or split the upload.tr: Daha küçük bir gövde gönderin veya yüklemeyi bölün.
Send a smaller body, or split the upload.vi: Gửi body nhỏ hơn, hoặc chia nhỏ phần tải lên.
Send a smaller body, or split the upload.ru: Отправьте тело поменьше или разбейте загрузку.
Send a smaller body, or split the upload.hi: छोटी बॉडी भेजें, या अपलोड को बाँट दें।

Raise the limit if you want larger files.es: Aumenta el límite si quieres permitir archivos más grandes: client_max_body_size en nginx, LimitRequestBody en Apache, además de cualquier límite de la aplicación.
Raise the limit if you want larger files.pt-BR: Aumente o limite se quiser arquivos maiores: client_max_body_size no nginx, LimitRequestBody no Apache, além de qualquer limite da aplicação.
Raise the limit if you want larger files.fr: Augmentez la limite si vous voulez accepter des fichiers plus gros : client_max_body_size dans nginx, LimitRequestBody dans Apache, ainsi que toute limite de l'application.
Raise the limit if you want larger files.de: Erhöhen Sie das Limit, wenn Sie größere Dateien wollen: client_max_body_size in nginx, LimitRequestBody in Apache, dazu jedes Limit der Anwendung.
Raise the limit if you want larger files.id: Naikkan batasnya jika Anda menginginkan file lebih besar: client_max_body_size di nginx, LimitRequestBody di Apache, ditambah batas aplikasi apa pun.
Raise the limit if you want larger files.it: Aumenta il limite se vuoi file più grandi: client_max_body_size in nginx, LimitRequestBody in Apache, più eventuali limiti dell'applicazione.
Raise the limit if you want larger files.tr: Daha büyük dosyalar istiyorsanız sınırı yükseltin: nginx'te client_max_body_size, Apache'de LimitRequestBody ve varsa uygulama sınırı.
Raise the limit if you want larger files.vi: Tăng giới hạn nếu bạn muốn tệp lớn hơn: client_max_body_size trong nginx, LimitRequestBody trong Apache, cùng mọi giới hạn của ứng dụng.
Raise the limit if you want larger files.ru: Чтобы разрешить файлы побольше, увеличьте лимит: client_max_body_size в nginx, LimitRequestBody в Apache и любой лимит приложения.
Raise the limit if you want larger files.hi: बड़ी फ़ाइलें चाहिए तो सीमा बढ़ाएँ: nginx में client_max_body_size, Apache में LimitRequestBody, और ऐप की कोई भी सीमा।
Raise the limit if you want larger files.pl: Zwiększ limit, jeśli chcesz większych plików: client_max_body_size w nginx, LimitRequestBody w Apache oraz ewentualny limit w aplikacji.

Sending JSON without Content-Type: appli.pt-BR: Enviar JSON sem Content-Type: application/json, ou postar um tipo de imagem que a API recusa.
Sending JSON without Content-Type: appli.fr: Envoi de JSON sans Content-Type: application/json, ou envoi d'un type d'image que l'API refuse.
Sending JSON without Content-Type: appli.de: JSON ohne Content-Type: application/json zu senden oder einen Bildtyp zu posten, den die API ablehnt.

Switch to the protocol named in the Upgr.es: Cambia al protocolo indicado en el encabezado Upgrade.
Switch to the protocol named in the Upgr.pt-BR: Mude para o protocolo indicado no cabeçalho Upgrade.
Switch to the protocol named in the Upgr.fr: Passez au protocole indiqué dans l'en-tête Upgrade.
Switch to the protocol named in the Upgr.de: Wechseln Sie zu dem Protokoll, das im Upgrade-Header genannt ist.
Switch to the protocol named in the Upgr.id: Beralih ke protokol yang disebut di header Upgrade.
Switch to the protocol named in the Upgr.it: Passa al protocollo indicato nell'intestazione Upgrade.
Switch to the protocol named in the Upgr.tr: Upgrade başlığında adı geçen protokole geçin.
Switch to the protocol named in the Upgr.vi: Chuyển sang giao thức nêu trong header Upgrade.
Switch to the protocol named in the Upgr.ru: Перейдите на протокол, указанный в заголовке Upgrade.
Switch to the protocol named in the Upgr.hi: Upgrade हेडर में बताए प्रोटोकॉल पर जाएँ।
Switch to the protocol named in the Upgr.pl: Przełącz się na protokół podany w nagłówku Upgrade.

Send an Upgrade header that names the pr.es: Envía un encabezado Upgrade que nombre el protocolo que requieres.
Send an Upgrade header that names the pr.pt-BR: Envie um cabeçalho Upgrade que indique o protocolo exigido.
Send an Upgrade header that names the pr.fr: Envoyez un en-tête Upgrade qui nomme le protocole que vous exigez.
Send an Upgrade header that names the pr.de: Senden Sie einen Upgrade-Header, der das von Ihnen verlangte Protokoll nennt.
Send an Upgrade header that names the pr.id: Kirim header Upgrade yang menyebutkan protokol yang Anda wajibkan.
Send an Upgrade header that names the pr.it: Invia un'intestazione Upgrade che indichi il protocollo richiesto.
Send an Upgrade header that names the pr.tr: Gerektirdiğiniz protokolü adıyla belirten bir Upgrade başlığı gönderin.
Send an Upgrade header that names the pr.vi: Gửi header Upgrade nêu giao thức bạn yêu cầu.
Send an Upgrade header that names the pr.ru: Отправляйте заголовок Upgrade с названием требуемого протокола.
Send an Upgrade header that names the pr.hi: ऐसा Upgrade हेडर भेजें जो आपके चाहे गए प्रोटोकॉल का नाम बताए।
Send an Upgrade header that names the pr.pl: Wyślij nagłówek Upgrade z nazwą wymaganego protokołu.

The server insists on a conditional requ.es: El servidor exige una solicitud condicional, para evitar actualizaciones perdidas.
The server insists on a conditional requ.pt-BR: O servidor exige uma requisição condicional, para evitar atualizações perdidas.
The server insists on a conditional requ.fr: Le serveur exige une requête conditionnelle, afin d'éviter les mises à jour perdues.
The server insists on a conditional requ.de: Der Server besteht auf einem bedingten Request, um verlorene Updates (Lost Updates) zu verhindern.
The server insists on a conditional requ.id: Server mewajibkan permintaan bersyarat, untuk mencegah lost update.
The server insists on a conditional requ.it: Il server pretende una richiesta condizionale, per evitare aggiornamenti persi.
The server insists on a conditional requ.tr: Sunucu, kayıp güncellemeleri önlemek için koşullu bir istek şart koşuyor.
The server insists on a conditional requ.vi: Máy chủ yêu cầu phải là yêu cầu có điều kiện, để tránh mất cập nhật.
The server insists on a conditional requ.ru: Сервер настаивает на условном запросе, чтобы предотвратить потерю обновлений.
The server insists on a conditional requ.hi: सर्वर कंडीशनल रिक्वेस्ट पर अड़ा है, ताकि अपडेट खोने से बचें।
The server insists on a conditional requ.pl: Serwer wymaga żądania warunkowego, aby zapobiec utracie aktualizacji.

APIs that demand If-Match on writes..pt-BR: APIs que exigem If-Match em escritas.
APIs that demand If-Match on writes..fr: API qui exigent If-Match lors des écritures.
APIs that demand If-Match on writes..de: APIs, die bei Schreibzugriffen If-Match verlangen.
APIs that demand If-Match on writes..id: API yang menuntut If-Match pada operasi tulis.
APIs that demand If-Match on writes..it: API che richiedono If-Match nelle scritture.
APIs that demand If-Match on writes..vi: Các API yêu cầu If-Match khi ghi.
APIs that demand If-Match on writes..hi: वे API जो लिखते समय If-Match माँगते हैं।
APIs that demand If-Match on writes..pl: API, które wymagają If-Match przy zapisie.

Fetch the resource, then send your chang.es: Obtén el recurso y luego envía tu cambio con un encabezado If-Match.
Fetch the resource, then send your chang.pt-BR: Busque o recurso e depois envie sua alteração com um cabeçalho If-Match.
Fetch the resource, then send your chang.fr: Récupérez la ressource, puis envoyez votre modification avec un en-tête If-Match.
Fetch the resource, then send your chang.de: Rufen Sie die Ressource ab und senden Sie Ihre Änderung dann mit einem If-Match-Header.
Fetch the resource, then send your chang.id: Ambil sumber daya, lalu kirim perubahan Anda dengan header If-Match.
Fetch the resource, then send your chang.it: Recupera la risorsa, poi invia la tua modifica con un'intestazione If-Match.
Fetch the resource, then send your chang.tr: Kaynağı getirin, ardından değişikliğinizi bir If-Match başlığıyla gönderin.
Fetch the resource, then send your chang.vi: Lấy tài nguyên, rồi gửi thay đổi của bạn kèm header If-Match.
Fetch the resource, then send your chang.ru: Получите ресурс, затем отправьте своё изменение с заголовком If-Match.
Fetch the resource, then send your chang.hi: संसाधन लाएँ, फिर अपना बदलाव If-Match हेडर के साथ भेजें।
Fetch the resource, then send your chang.pl: Pobierz zasób, a potem wyślij zmianę z nagłówkiem If-Match.

Return it to stop clients overwriting ch.es: Devuélvelo para evitar que los clientes sobrescriban cambios que no han visto.
Return it to stop clients overwriting ch.pt-BR: Retorne-o para impedir que os clientes sobrescrevam alterações que não viram.
Return it to stop clients overwriting ch.fr: Renvoyez-le pour empêcher les clients d'écraser des modifications qu'ils n'ont pas vues.
Return it to stop clients overwriting ch.de: Geben Sie ihn zurück, damit Clients keine Änderungen überschreiben, die sie nicht gesehen haben.
Return it to stop clients overwriting ch.id: Kembalikan untuk mencegah klien menimpa perubahan yang belum mereka lihat.
Return it to stop clients overwriting ch.it: Restituiscilo per impedire ai client di sovrascrivere modifiche che non hanno visto.
Return it to stop clients overwriting ch.tr: İstemcilerin görmedikleri değişikliklerin üzerine yazmasını önlemek için döndürün.
Return it to stop clients overwriting ch.vi: Trả về để ngăn máy khách ghi đè các thay đổi mà họ chưa thấy.
Return it to stop clients overwriting ch.ru: Возвращайте, чтобы клиенты не перезаписывали изменения, которых не видели.
Return it to stop clients overwriting ch.hi: इसे इसलिए लौटाएँ कि क्लाइंट वे बदलाव न मिटा दें जो उन्होंने देखे नहीं।
Return it to stop clients overwriting ch.pl: Zwracaj go, aby klienci nie nadpisywali zmian, których nie widzieli.

The client has sent too many requests in.es: El cliente envió demasiadas solicitudes en un período determinado (limitación de tasa).
The client has sent too many requests in.pt-BR: O cliente enviou requisições demais em um determinado período (rate limiting).
The client has sent too many requests in.fr: Le client a envoyé trop de requêtes sur une période donnée (limitation de débit).
The client has sent too many requests in.de: Der Client hat in einem bestimmten Zeitraum zu viele Anfragen gesendet (Rate Limiting).
The client has sent too many requests in.id: Klien telah mengirim terlalu banyak permintaan dalam periode tertentu (rate limiting).
The client has sent too many requests in.it: Il client ha inviato troppe richieste in un dato periodo (limitazione della frequenza).
The client has sent too many requests in.tr: İstemci belirli bir sürede çok fazla istek gönderdi (hız sınırlama).
The client has sent too many requests in.vi: Máy khách đã gửi quá nhiều yêu cầu trong một khoảng thời gian (giới hạn tốc độ).
The client has sent too many requests in.ru: Клиент отправил слишком много запросов за заданный период (ограничение частоты).
The client has sent too many requests in.hi: क्लाइंट ने एक तय अवधि में बहुत ज़्यादा रिक्वेस्ट भेज दी हैं (रेट लिमिटिंग)।
The client has sent too many requests in.pl: Klient wysłał zbyt wiele żądań w danym okresie (ograniczanie liczby żądań).

API rate limits, login throttling and bo.es: Límites de tasa de API, limitación de inicios de sesión y protección contra bots.
API rate limits, login throttling and bo.pt-BR: Limites de taxa de APIs, throttling de login e proteção contra bots.
API rate limits, login throttling and bo.fr: Limites de débit d'API, limitation des tentatives de connexion et protection contre les robots.
API rate limits, login throttling and bo.id: Rate limit API, throttling login, dan perlindungan bot.
API rate limits, login throttling and bo.it: Limiti di frequenza delle API, rallentamento dei login e protezione dai bot.
API rate limits, login throttling and bo.tr: API hız sınırları, oturum açma kısıtlaması ve bot koruması.
API rate limits, login throttling and bo.vi: Giới hạn tốc độ API, hạn chế đăng nhập và chống bot.
API rate limits, login throttling and bo.ru: Лимиты частоты API, замедление входа и защита от ботов.
API rate limits, login throttling and bo.hi: API रेट लिमिट, लॉगिन थ्रॉटलिंग और बॉट सुरक्षा।
API rate limits, login throttling and bo.pl: Limity żądań API, spowalnianie logowania i ochrona przed botami.

Slow down and wait. Respect the Retry-Af.es: Reduce la velocidad y espera. Respeta el encabezado Retry-After y aplica un retroceso exponencial.
Slow down and wait. Respect the Retry-Af.pt-BR: Diminua o ritmo e espere. Respeite o cabeçalho Retry-After e use backoff exponencial.
Slow down and wait. Respect the Retry-Af.fr: Ralentissez et attendez. Respectez l'en-tête Retry-After et espacez vos tentatives de façon exponentielle.
Slow down and wait. Respect the Retry-Af.de: Senden Sie langsamer und warten Sie. Beachten Sie den Retry-After-Header und verlängern Sie die Wartezeit exponentiell (Backoff).
Slow down and wait. Respect the Retry-Af.id: Perlambat dan tunggu. Patuhi header Retry-After, dan beri jeda yang makin lama setiap kali mencoba ulang (exponential backoff).
Slow down and wait. Respect the Retry-Af.it: Rallenta e attendi. Rispetta l'intestazione Retry-After e aumenta gradualmente l'attesa in modo esponenziale.
Slow down and wait. Respect the Retry-Af.tr: Yavaşlayın ve bekleyin. Retry-After başlığına uyun ve üstel olarak geri çekilin.
Slow down and wait. Respect the Retry-Af.vi: Chậm lại và chờ. Tuân theo header Retry-After, và giãn cách theo cấp số nhân.
Slow down and wait. Respect the Retry-Af.ru: Замедлитесь и подождите. Учитывайте заголовок Retry-After и увеличивайте паузы экспоненциально.
Slow down and wait. Respect the Retry-Af.hi: धीमे हो जाएँ और इंतज़ार करें। Retry-After हेडर का सम्मान करें, और एक्सपोनेंशियल बैकऑफ़ अपनाएँ।
Slow down and wait. Respect the Retry-Af.pl: Zwolnij i poczekaj. Przestrzegaj nagłówka Retry-After i wydłużaj odstępy wykładniczo.

Send Retry-After and rate limit headers.es: Envía Retry-After y los encabezados de límite de tasa para que los clientes puedan comportarse bien. Asegúrate de que los usuarios legítimos no queden bloqueados por un límite de IP compartida.
Send Retry-After and rate limit headers.pt-BR: Envie Retry-After e cabeçalhos de rate limit para que os clientes possam se comportar. Garanta que usuários legítimos não sejam pegos por um limite de IP compartilhado.
Send Retry-After and rate limit headers.fr: Envoyez Retry-After et les en-têtes de limite de débit pour que les clients puissent s'adapter. Veillez à ce que les utilisateurs légitimes ne soient pas pénalisés par une limite portant sur une IP partagée.
Send Retry-After and rate limit headers.de: Senden Sie Retry-After und Rate-Limit-Header, damit Clients sich entsprechend verhalten können. Stellen Sie sicher, dass legitime Benutzer nicht von einem Limit für eine gemeinsam genutzte IP erfasst werden.
Send Retry-After and rate limit headers.id: Kirim Retry-After dan header rate limit agar klien dapat menyesuaikan diri. Pastikan pengguna yang sah tidak terkena batas IP bersama.
Send Retry-After and rate limit headers.it: Invia Retry-After e le intestazioni sul limite di frequenza in modo che i client possano comportarsi di conseguenza. Assicurati che gli utenti legittimi non vengano bloccati da un limite su un IP condiviso.
Send Retry-After and rate limit headers.tr: İstemciler doğru davranabilsin diye Retry-After ve hız sınırı başlıklarını gönderin. Meşru kullanıcıların ortak bir IP sınırına takılmadığından emin olun.
Send Retry-After and rate limit headers.vi: Gửi Retry-After và các header giới hạn tốc độ để máy khách xử lý đúng. Đảm bảo người dùng hợp lệ không bị vướng vào giới hạn theo IP dùng chung.
Send Retry-After and rate limit headers.ru: Отправляйте Retry-After и заголовки лимитов, чтобы клиенты могли подстроиться. Следите, чтобы добросовестные пользователи не попадали под лимит общего IP.
Send Retry-After and rate limit headers.hi: Retry-After और रेट लिमिट हेडर भेजें ताकि क्लाइंट सही व्यवहार कर सकें। ध्यान रखें कि साझा IP की सीमा में असली यूज़र न फँसें।
Send Retry-After and rate limit headers.pl: Wysyłaj Retry-After i nagłówki limitów, aby klienci mogli się dostosować. Upewnij się, że uprawnieni użytkownicy nie wpadają w limit dla wspólnego adresu IP.

The request headers, or one header, are.es: Los encabezados de la solicitud, o uno de ellos, son demasiado grandes.
The request headers, or one header, are.pt-BR: Os cabeçalhos da requisição, ou um deles, são grandes demais.
The request headers, or one header, are.fr: Les en-têtes de la requête, ou l'un d'eux, sont trop volumineux.
The request headers, or one header, are.de: Die Request-Header oder ein einzelner Header sind zu groß.
The request headers, or one header, are.id: Header permintaan, atau salah satu header, terlalu besar.
The request headers, or one header, are.it: Le intestazioni della richiesta, o una di esse, sono troppo grandi.
The request headers, or one header, are.tr: İstek başlıkları veya bir başlık çok büyük.
The request headers, or one header, are.vi: Các header của yêu cầu, hoặc một header, quá lớn.
The request headers, or one header, are.ru: Заголовки запроса или один из них слишком велики.
The request headers, or one header, are.hi: रिक्वेस्ट हेडर, या कोई एक हेडर, बहुत बड़ा है।
The request headers, or one header, are.pl: Nagłówki żądania, lub jeden z nich, są zbyt duże.

Oversized cookies, or a very long Author.es: Cookies enormes, o un encabezado Authorization o Referer muy largo.
Oversized cookies, or a very long Author.pt-BR: Cookies enormes ou um cabeçalho Authorization ou Referer muito longo.
Oversized cookies, or a very long Author.fr: Cookies trop gros, ou en-tête Authorization ou Referer très long.
Oversized cookies, or a very long Author.de: Übergroße Cookies oder ein sehr langer Authorization- oder Referer-Header.
Oversized cookies, or a very long Author.id: Cookie yang terlalu besar, atau header Authorization atau Referer yang sangat panjang.
Oversized cookies, or a very long Author.it: Cookie di dimensioni eccessive, oppure un'intestazione Authorization o Referer molto lunga.
Oversized cookies, or a very long Author.tr: Aşırı büyük çerezler veya çok uzun bir Authorization ya da Referer başlığı.
Oversized cookies, or a very long Author.vi: Cookie quá lớn, hoặc header Authorization hay Referer rất dài.
Oversized cookies, or a very long Author.ru: Слишком большие cookie или очень длинный заголовок Authorization или Referer.
Oversized cookies, or a very long Author.hi: बहुत बड़ी कुकी, या बहुत लंबा Authorization या Referer हेडर।
Oversized cookies, or a very long Author.pl: Zbyt duże pliki cookie albo bardzo długi nagłówek Authorization lub Referer.

Clear cookies for the site, or send fewe.es: Borra las cookies del sitio, o envía menos encabezados.
Clear cookies for the site, or send fewe.pt-BR: Limpe os cookies do site ou envie menos cabeçalhos.
Clear cookies for the site, or send fewe.fr: Effacez les cookies du site, ou envoyez moins d'en-têtes.
Clear cookies for the site, or send fewe.de: Löschen Sie die Cookies der Website oder senden Sie weniger Header.
Clear cookies for the site, or send fewe.id: Hapus cookie untuk situs tersebut, atau kirim lebih sedikit header.
Clear cookies for the site, or send fewe.it: Cancella i cookie del sito, oppure invia meno intestazioni.
Clear cookies for the site, or send fewe.tr: Site için çerezleri temizleyin veya daha az başlık gönderin.
Clear cookies for the site, or send fewe.vi: Xóa cookie của trang, hoặc gửi ít header hơn.
Clear cookies for the site, or send fewe.ru: Очистите cookie для сайта или отправляйте меньше заголовков.
Clear cookies for the site, or send fewe.hi: उस साइट की कुकी साफ़ करें, या कम हेडर भेजें।
Clear cookies for the site, or send fewe.pl: Wyczyść pliki cookie witryny albo wyślij mniej nagłówków.

Raise header limits only when needed, an.es: Aumenta los límites de encabezados solo cuando haga falta, y evita que las cookies crezcan sin control.
Raise header limits only when needed, an.pt-BR: Aumente os limites de cabeçalho só quando necessário e impeça que os cookies cresçam sem limite.
Raise header limits only when needed, an.fr: N'augmentez les limites d'en-têtes qu'en cas de besoin, et empêchez les cookies de grossir sans limite.
Raise header limits only when needed, an.de: Erhöhen Sie Header-Limits nur bei Bedarf und verhindern Sie, dass Cookies unbegrenzt wachsen.
Raise header limits only when needed, an.id: Naikkan batas header hanya bila perlu, dan cegah cookie tumbuh tanpa batas.
Raise header limits only when needed, an.it: Aumenta i limiti delle intestazioni solo se necessario e impedisci che i cookie crescano senza limiti.
Raise header limits only when needed, an.tr: Başlık sınırlarını yalnızca gerekirse yükseltin ve çerezlerin sınırsız büyümesini durdurun.
Raise header limits only when needed, an.vi: Chỉ tăng giới hạn header khi cần, và ngăn cookie phình to không kiểm soát.
Raise header limits only when needed, an.ru: Увеличивайте лимиты заголовков только при необходимости и не давайте cookie расти без предела.
Raise header limits only when needed, an.hi: हेडर की सीमा तभी बढ़ाएँ जब ज़रूरत हो, और कुकी को बेहिसाब बढ़ने से रोकें।
Raise header limits only when needed, an.pl: Zwiększaj limity nagłówków tylko w razie potrzeby i nie pozwalaj, by pliki cookie rosły bez ograniczeń.

The resource is blocked because of a leg.pt-BR: O recurso está bloqueado por causa de uma exigência legal.

The resource is blocked because of a leg.tr: Kaynak, yasal bir talep nedeniyle engellendi.
The resource is blocked because of a leg.vi: Tài nguyên bị chặn vì yêu cầu pháp lý.
The resource is blocked because of a leg.hi: क़ानूनी माँग के कारण संसाधन ब्लॉक है।
The resource is blocked because of a leg.pl: Zasób jest zablokowany z powodu żądania prawnego.
