Content removed after a court order, or.pt-BR: Conteúdo removido após uma ordem judicial ou bloqueado em um país por lei.
Content removed after a court order, or.fr: Contenu retiré après une décision de justice, ou bloqué dans un pays par la loi.
Content removed after a court order, or.de: Inhalte, die nach einem Gerichtsbeschluss entfernt wurden oder in einem Land gesetzlich gesperrt sind.
Content removed after a court order, or.id: Konten yang dihapus setelah perintah pengadilan, atau diblokir di suatu negara oleh hukum.
Content removed after a court order, or.it: Contenuti rimossi dopo un ordine del tribunale, o bloccati in un paese per legge.
Content removed after a court order, or.tr: Mahkeme kararı üzerine kaldırılan veya bir ülkede yasa gereği engellenen içerik.
Content removed after a court order, or.vi: Nội dung bị gỡ theo lệnh của tòa án, hoặc bị chặn ở một quốc gia theo luật.
Content removed after a court order, or.ru: Содержимое удалено по решению суда или заблокировано в стране по закону.
Content removed after a court order, or.hi: अदालती आदेश के बाद हटाई गई सामग्री, या किसी देश में क़ानून द्वारा ब्लॉक सामग्री।
Content removed after a court order, or.pl: Treść usunięta po nakazie sądowym albo zablokowana w kraju na mocy prawa.

There is nothing to fix in the request..es: No hay nada que corregir en la solicitud. El encabezado Link puede indicar quién lo bloqueó.
There is nothing to fix in the request..pt-BR: Não há nada a corrigir na requisição. O cabeçalho Link pode indicar quem o bloqueou.
There is nothing to fix in the request..fr: Il n'y a rien à corriger dans la requête. L'en-tête Link peut indiquer qui l'a bloquée.
There is nothing to fix in the request..de: An der Anfrage gibt es nichts zu korrigieren. Der Link-Header nennt möglicherweise, wer die Sperre veranlasst hat.
There is nothing to fix in the request..id: Tidak ada yang perlu diperbaiki pada permintaan. Header Link mungkin menyebut siapa yang memblokirnya.
There is nothing to fix in the request..it: Non c'è nulla da correggere nella richiesta. L'intestazione Link può indicare chi l'ha bloccata.
There is nothing to fix in the request..tr: İstekte düzeltilecek bir şey yok. Link başlığı, engelleyenin kim olduğunu belirtebilir.
There is nothing to fix in the request..vi: Không có gì cần sửa trong yêu cầu. Header Link có thể nêu ai đã chặn.
There is nothing to fix in the request..ru: В запросе исправлять нечего. Заголовок Link может указывать, кто заблокировал ресурс.
There is nothing to fix in the request..hi: रिक्वेस्ट में ठीक करने को कुछ नहीं है। Link हेडर बता सकता है कि इसे किसने ब्लॉक किया।
There is nothing to fix in the request..pl: W żądaniu nie ma nic do poprawienia. Nagłówek Link może wskazywać, kto go zablokował.

Use it to show a legal block openly inst.es: Úsalo para mostrar abiertamente un bloqueo legal en lugar de un 403 o un 404.
Use it to show a legal block openly inst.pt-BR: Use-o para mostrar um bloqueio legal às claras, em vez de um 403 ou 404.
Use it to show a legal block openly inst.fr: Utilisez-le pour signaler ouvertement un blocage légal plutôt qu'un 403 ou un 404.
Use it to show a legal block openly inst.de: Verwenden Sie ihn, um eine rechtliche Sperre offen anzuzeigen, statt 403 oder 404 zu verwenden.
Use it to show a legal block openly inst.id: Gunakan untuk menunjukkan pemblokiran hukum secara terbuka, alih-alih 403 atau 404.
Use it to show a legal block openly inst.it: Usalo per mostrare apertamente un blocco legale invece di un 403 o un 404.
Use it to show a legal block openly inst.tr: Yasal bir engeli 403 veya 404 ile gizlemek yerine açıkça göstermek için kullanın.
Use it to show a legal block openly inst.vi: Dùng để thể hiện công khai việc chặn theo pháp luật thay vì 403 hoặc 404.
Use it to show a legal block openly inst.ru: Используйте, чтобы открыто показать юридическую блокировку вместо 403 или 404.
Use it to show a legal block openly inst.hi: क़ानूनी ब्लॉक को 403 या 404 की जगह खुलकर दिखाने के लिए इस्तेमाल करें।
Use it to show a legal block openly inst.pl: Używaj go, aby otwarcie pokazać blokadę prawną zamiast 403 lub 404.

A general error: the server hit a proble.es: Un error general: el servidor encontró un problema que no esperaba.
A general error: the server hit a proble.pt-BR: Um erro genérico: o servidor encontrou um problema que não esperava.
A general error: the server hit a proble.fr: Une erreur générale : le serveur a rencontré un problème inattendu.
A general error: the server hit a proble.de: Ein allgemeiner Fehler: Der Server ist auf ein unerwartetes Problem gestoßen.
A general error: the server hit a proble.id: Kesalahan umum: server mengalami masalah yang tidak terduga.
A general error: the server hit a proble.it: Un errore generico: il server ha incontrato un problema che non si aspettava.
A general error: the server hit a proble.tr: Genel bir hata: sunucu beklemediği bir sorunla karşılaştı.
A general error: the server hit a proble.vi: Lỗi chung: máy chủ gặp sự cố không lường trước.
A general error: the server hit a proble.ru: Общая ошибка: сервер столкнулся с непредвиденной проблемой.
A general error: the server hit a proble.hi: एक सामान्य त्रुटि: सर्वर को ऐसी समस्या मिली जिसकी उसे उम्मीद नहीं थी।
A general error: the server hit a proble.pl: Ogólny błąd: serwer napotkał nieoczekiwany problem.

An unhandled exception, a crashed script.es: Una excepción no controlada, un script que se cayó, una mala configuración o una dependencia que falla.
An unhandled exception, a crashed script.pt-BR: Uma exceção não tratada, um script que travou, uma configuração ruim ou uma dependência com falha.
An unhandled exception, a crashed script.fr: Exception non gérée, script planté, mauvaise configuration ou dépendance défaillante.
An unhandled exception, a crashed script.de: Eine unbehandelte Exception, ein abgestürztes Skript, eine fehlerhafte Konfiguration oder eine ausfallende Abhängigkeit.
An unhandled exception, a crashed script.id: Exception yang tidak tertangani, skrip yang crash, konfigurasi yang salah, atau dependensi yang gagal.
An unhandled exception, a crashed script.it: Un'eccezione non gestita, uno script andato in crash, una configurazione errata o una dipendenza che non funziona.
An unhandled exception, a crashed script.tr: Yakalanmamış bir istisna, çöken bir betik, hatalı bir yapılandırma veya başarısız bir bağımlılık.
An unhandled exception, a crashed script.vi: Ngoại lệ không được xử lý, script bị sập, cấu hình sai hoặc một phụ thuộc bị lỗi.
An unhandled exception, a crashed script.ru: Необработанное исключение, аварийно завершившийся скрипт, неверная конфигурация или сбойная зависимость.
An unhandled exception, a crashed script.hi: अनहैंडल्ड एक्सेप्शन, क्रैश हुई स्क्रिप्ट, ग़लत कॉन्फ़िगरेशन या फ़ेल होती निर्भरता।
An unhandled exception, a crashed script.pl: Nieobsłużony wyjątek, zawieszony skrypt, błędna konfiguracja lub niedziałająca zależność.

Retry later. If it keeps happening, repo.es: Reintenta más tarde. Si sigue ocurriendo, repórtalo al responsable del sitio.
Retry later. If it keeps happening, repo.pt-BR: Tente mais tarde. Se continuar acontecendo, avise o dono do site.
Retry later. If it keeps happening, repo.fr: Réessayez plus tard. Si cela persiste, signalez-le au propriétaire du site.
Retry later. If it keeps happening, repo.de: Versuchen Sie es später erneut. Tritt es weiterhin auf, melden Sie es dem Betreiber der Website.
Retry later. If it keeps happening, repo.id: Coba lagi nanti. Jika terus terjadi, laporkan kepada pemilik situs.
Retry later. If it keeps happening, repo.it: Riprova più tardi. Se continua a succedere, segnalalo al proprietario del sito.
Retry later. If it keeps happening, repo.tr: Daha sonra yeniden deneyin. Sürekli olursa site sahibine bildirin.
Retry later. If it keeps happening, repo.vi: Thử lại sau. Nếu vẫn tiếp diễn, hãy báo cho chủ trang.
Retry later. If it keeps happening, repo.ru: Повторите позже. Если это продолжается, сообщите владельцу сайта.
Retry later. If it keeps happening, repo.hi: बाद में दोबारा कोशिश करें। अगर यह होता रहे, तो साइट के मालिक को बताएँ।
Retry later. If it keeps happening, repo.pl: Spróbuj ponownie później. Jeśli problem się powtarza, zgłoś go właścicielowi witryny.

Read the server logs. Do not expose stac.es: Lee los registros del servidor. No expongas stack traces a los usuarios. Devuelve un 5xx más específico cuando puedas.
Read the server logs. Do not expose stac.pt-BR: Leia os logs do servidor. Não exponha stack traces aos usuários. Retorne um 5xx mais específico quando puder.
Read the server logs. Do not expose stac.fr: Lisez les journaux du serveur. N'exposez pas les traces d'appels aux utilisateurs. Renvoyez un 5xx plus précis quand vous le pouvez.
Read the server logs. Do not expose stac.de: Lesen Sie die Server-Logs. Zeigen Sie Benutzern keine Stack Traces an. Geben Sie nach Möglichkeit einen spezifischeren 5xx zurück.
Read the server logs. Do not expose stac.id: Baca log server. Jangan tampilkan stack trace kepada pengguna. Kembalikan 5xx yang lebih spesifik jika bisa.
Read the server logs. Do not expose stac.it: Leggi i log del server. Non esporre gli stack trace agli utenti. Restituisci un 5xx più specifico quando puoi.
Read the server logs. Do not expose stac.tr: Sunucu günlüklerini okuyun. Yığın izlerini kullanıcılara göstermeyin. Mümkünse daha belirli bir 5xx döndürün.
Read the server logs. Do not expose stac.vi: Đọc log của máy chủ. Đừng để lộ stack trace cho người dùng. Trả về mã 5xx cụ thể hơn khi có thể.
Read the server logs. Do not expose stac.ru: Читайте журналы сервера. Не показывайте пользователям трассировки стека. По возможности возвращайте более конкретный код 5xx.
Read the server logs. Do not expose stac.hi: सर्वर लॉग पढ़ें। यूज़र को स्टैक ट्रेस न दिखाएँ। हो सके तो ज़्यादा ख़ास 5xx लौटाएँ।
Read the server logs. Do not expose stac.pl: Przeczytaj logi serwera. Nie ujawniaj użytkownikom śladów stosu. Zwracaj bardziej szczegółowy kod 5xx, gdy możesz.

The server does not support the request.es: El servidor no admite el método ni la función de la solicitud.
The server does not support the request.pt-BR: O servidor não suporta o método ou o recurso da requisição.
The server does not support the request.fr: Le serveur ne prend pas en charge la méthode ou la fonctionnalité de la requête.
The server does not support the request.de: Der Server unterstützt die Request-Methode oder die Funktion nicht.
The server does not support the request.id: Server tidak mendukung method atau fitur yang diminta.
The server does not support the request.it: Il server non supporta il metodo o la funzionalità richiesti.
The server does not support the request.tr: Sunucu istek yöntemini veya özelliğini desteklemiyor.
The server does not support the request.vi: Máy chủ không hỗ trợ phương thức hoặc tính năng của yêu cầu.
The server does not support the request.ru: Сервер не поддерживает метод запроса или возможность.
The server does not support the request.hi: सर्वर रिक्वेस्ट मेथड या फ़ीचर को सपोर्ट नहीं करता।
The server does not support the request.pl: Serwer nie obsługuje metody żądania ani funkcji.

An unusual HTTP method or a feature the.es: Un método HTTP poco común o una función que el servidor no tiene.
An unusual HTTP method or a feature the.pt-BR: Um método HTTP incomum ou um recurso que o servidor não tem.
An unusual HTTP method or a feature the.fr: Une méthode HTTP inhabituelle ou une fonctionnalité que le serveur n'a pas.
An unusual HTTP method or a feature the.de: Eine ungewöhnliche HTTP-Methode oder eine Funktion, die dem Server fehlt.
An unusual HTTP method or a feature the.id: Method HTTP yang tidak lazim atau fitur yang tidak dimiliki server.
An unusual HTTP method or a feature the.it: Un metodo HTTP insolito o una funzionalità che il server non ha.
An unusual HTTP method or a feature the.tr: Alışılmadık bir HTTP yöntemi veya sunucuda olmayan bir özellik.
An unusual HTTP method or a feature the.vi: Một phương thức HTTP hiếm gặp hoặc tính năng mà máy chủ không có.
An unusual HTTP method or a feature the.ru: Необычный метод HTTP или возможность, которой нет у сервера.
An unusual HTTP method or a feature the.hi: कोई असामान्य HTTP मेथड या ऐसा फ़ीचर जो सर्वर में नहीं है।
An unusual HTTP method or a feature the.pl: Nietypowa metoda HTTP albo funkcja, której serwer nie ma.

Do not retry; use a different method or.es: No reintentes; usa otro método o servicio.
Do not retry; use a different method or.pt-BR: Não tente de novo; use outro método ou serviço.
Do not retry; use a different method or.fr: Ne réessayez pas ; utilisez une autre méthode ou un autre service.
Do not retry; use a different method or.de: Wiederholen Sie die Anfrage nicht; verwenden Sie eine andere Methode oder einen anderen Dienst.
Do not retry; use a different method or.id: Jangan ulangi; gunakan method atau layanan lain.
Do not retry; use a different method or.it: Non riprovare; usa un metodo o un servizio diverso.
Do not retry; use a different method or.tr: Yeniden denemeyin; farklı bir yöntem veya hizmet kullanın.
Do not retry; use a different method or.vi: Đừng thử lại; hãy dùng phương thức hoặc dịch vụ khác.
Do not retry; use a different method or.ru: Не повторяйте; используйте другой метод или сервис.
Do not retry; use a different method or.hi: दोबारा कोशिश न करें; कोई दूसरा मेथड या सेवा इस्तेमाल करें।
Do not retry; use a different method or.pl: Nie ponawiaj; użyj innej metody lub usługi.

Return it for methods you do not support.es: Devuélvelo para métodos que no admites en absoluto. Usa 405 para métodos que admites en otros recursos.
Return it for methods you do not support.pt-BR: Retorne-o para métodos que você não suporta de jeito nenhum. Use 405 para métodos que você suporta em outros lugares.
Return it for methods you do not support.fr: Renvoyez-le pour les méthodes que vous ne prenez pas du tout en charge. Utilisez 405 pour les méthodes que vous prenez en charge ailleurs.
Return it for methods you do not support.de: Geben Sie ihn für Methoden zurück, die Sie überhaupt nicht unterstützen. Verwenden Sie 405 für Methoden, die Sie an anderer Stelle unterstützen.
Return it for methods you do not support.id: Kembalikan untuk method yang sama sekali tidak Anda dukung. Gunakan 405 untuk method yang Anda dukung di tempat lain.
Return it for methods you do not support.it: Restituiscilo per i metodi che non supporti affatto. Usa 405 per i metodi che supporti altrove.
Return it for methods you do not support.tr: Hiç desteklemediğiniz yöntemler için döndürün. Başka yerlerde desteklediğiniz yöntemler için 405 kullanın.
Return it for methods you do not support.vi: Trả về cho các phương thức bạn hoàn toàn không hỗ trợ. Dùng 405 cho các phương thức bạn hỗ trợ ở nơi khác.
Return it for methods you do not support.ru: Возвращайте для методов, которые вы не поддерживаете вовсе. Для методов, поддерживаемых в других местах, используйте 405.
Return it for methods you do not support.hi: उन मेथड के लिए लौटाएँ जिन्हें आप बिल्कुल सपोर्ट नहीं करते। जिन मेथड को कहीं और सपोर्ट करते हैं, उनके लिए 405 इस्तेमाल करें।
Return it for methods you do not support.pl: Zwracaj go dla metod, których w ogóle nie obsługujesz. Użyj 405 dla metod obsługiwanych gdzie indziej.

A gateway or proxy got an invalid respon.es: Un gateway o proxy recibió una respuesta inválida del servidor que tiene detrás.
A gateway or proxy got an invalid respon.pt-BR: Um gateway ou proxy recebeu uma resposta inválida do servidor que fica atrás dele.
A gateway or proxy got an invalid respon.fr: Une passerelle ou un proxy a reçu une réponse invalide du serveur situé derrière lui.
A gateway or proxy got an invalid respon.de: Ein Gateway oder Proxy hat vom dahinterliegenden Server eine ungültige Antwort erhalten.
A gateway or proxy got an invalid respon.id: Gateway atau proxy menerima respons tidak valid dari server di belakangnya.
A gateway or proxy got an invalid respon.it: Un gateway o un proxy ha ricevuto una risposta non valida dal server che si trova dietro.
A gateway or proxy got an invalid respon.tr: Bir ağ geçidi veya vekil sunucu, arkasındaki sunucudan geçersiz bir yanıt aldı.
A gateway or proxy got an invalid respon.vi: Một gateway hoặc proxy nhận được phản hồi không hợp lệ từ máy chủ phía sau nó.
A gateway or proxy got an invalid respon.ru: Шлюз или прокси получил недопустимый ответ от сервера за ним.
A gateway or proxy got an invalid respon.hi: गेटवे या प्रॉक्सी को अपने पीछे के सर्वर से अमान्य जवाब मिला।
A gateway or proxy got an invalid respon.pl: Brama lub serwer proxy otrzymały nieprawidłową odpowiedź od serwera za nimi.

A crashed or restarting backend, wrong u.es: Un backend caído o que se está reiniciando, una dirección upstream incorrecta, o un proxy inverso que no puede alcanzar la aplicación.
A crashed or restarting backend, wrong u.pt-BR: Um backend que travou ou está reiniciando, endereço de upstream errado ou um proxy reverso que não consegue alcançar a aplicação.
A crashed or restarting backend, wrong u.fr: Backend planté ou en cours de redémarrage, mauvaise adresse en amont, ou reverse proxy qui ne parvient pas à joindre l'application.
A crashed or restarting backend, wrong u.de: Ein abgestürztes oder neu startendes Backend, eine falsche Upstream-Adresse oder ein Reverse Proxy, der die Anwendung nicht erreichen kann.
A crashed or restarting backend, wrong u.id: Backend yang crash atau restart, alamat upstream yang salah, atau reverse proxy yang tidak dapat menjangkau aplikasi.
A crashed or restarting backend, wrong u.it: Un backend in crash o in riavvio, un indirizzo upstream sbagliato, oppure un reverse proxy che non riesce a raggiungere l'app.
A crashed or restarting backend, wrong u.tr: Çöken veya yeniden başlayan bir arka uç, yanlış üst akış adresi veya uygulamaya ulaşamayan bir ters vekil sunucu.
A crashed or restarting backend, wrong u.vi: Backend bị sập hoặc đang khởi động lại, sai địa chỉ upstream, hoặc reverse proxy không kết nối được tới ứng dụng.
A crashed or restarting backend, wrong u.ru: Упавший или перезапускающийся бэкенд, неверный адрес upstream или обратный прокси, не достающий до приложения.
A crashed or restarting backend, wrong u.hi: क्रैश हुआ या रीस्टार्ट होता बैकएंड, ग़लत अपस्ट्रीम पता, या ऐसा रिवर्स प्रॉक्सी जो ऐप तक नहीं पहुँच पा रहा।
A crashed or restarting backend, wrong u.pl: Zawieszony lub restartujący się backend, zły adres upstream albo reverse proxy, które nie może dotrzeć do aplikacji.

Wait and retry. If it persists, tell the.es: Espera y reintenta. Si persiste, avisa al responsable del sitio.
Wait and retry. If it persists, tell the.pt-BR: Espere e tente de novo. Se persistir, avise o dono do site.
Wait and retry. If it persists, tell the.fr: Attendez et réessayez. Si le problème persiste, prévenez le propriétaire du site.
Wait and retry. If it persists, tell the.de: Warten Sie und versuchen Sie es erneut. Besteht das Problem weiter, informieren Sie den Betreiber der Website.
Wait and retry. If it persists, tell the.id: Tunggu dan coba lagi. Jika berlanjut, beri tahu pemilik situs.
Wait and retry. If it persists, tell the.it: Attendi e riprova. Se persiste, avvisa il proprietario del sito.
Wait and retry. If it persists, tell the.tr: Bekleyin ve yeniden deneyin. Sürerse site sahibine bildirin.
Wait and retry. If it persists, tell the.vi: Chờ và thử lại. Nếu vẫn còn, hãy báo cho chủ trang.
Wait and retry. If it persists, tell the.ru: Подождите и повторите. Если не проходит, сообщите владельцу сайта.
Wait and retry. If it persists, tell the.hi: इंतज़ार करें और दोबारा कोशिश करें। अगर बना रहे, तो साइट के मालिक को बताएँ।
Wait and retry. If it persists, tell the.pl: Poczekaj i spróbuj ponownie. Jeśli problem trwa, powiadom właściciela witryny.

Check that the upstream is running and r.es: Comprueba que el upstream esté en ejecución y accesible, y lee el registro de errores del proxy (nginx, un balanceador de carga o un CDN).
Check that the upstream is running and r.pt-BR: Verifique se o upstream está rodando e acessível e leia o log de erros do proxy (nginx, um balanceador de carga ou uma CDN).
Check that the upstream is running and r.fr: Vérifiez que le serveur en amont fonctionne et est joignable, et lisez le journal d'erreurs du proxy (nginx, répartiteur de charge ou CDN).
Check that the upstream is running and r.de: Prüfen Sie, ob der Upstream läuft und erreichbar ist, und lesen Sie das Fehlerlog des Proxys (nginx, Load Balancer oder CDN).
Check that the upstream is running and r.id: Periksa apakah upstream berjalan dan dapat dijangkau, dan baca error log proxy (nginx, load balancer, atau CDN).
Check that the upstream is running and r.it: Verifica che l'upstream sia in esecuzione e raggiungibile e leggi il log degli errori del proxy (nginx, un bilanciatore di carico o una CDN).
Check that the upstream is running and r.tr: Üst akışın çalıştığını ve erişilebilir olduğunu kontrol edin ve vekil sunucunun (nginx, bir yük dengeleyici veya bir CDN) hata günlüğünü okuyun.
Check that the upstream is running and r.vi: Kiểm tra xem upstream có đang chạy và truy cập được không, và đọc log lỗi của proxy (nginx, bộ cân bằng tải hoặc CDN).
Check that the upstream is running and r.ru: Проверьте, что upstream запущен и доступен, и прочитайте журнал ошибок прокси (nginx, балансировщика нагрузки или CDN).
Check that the upstream is running and r.hi: जाँचें कि अपस्ट्रीम चल रहा है और पहुँच में है, और प्रॉक्सी का एरर लॉग पढ़ें (nginx, लोड बैलेंसर या CDN)।
Check that the upstream is running and r.pl: Sprawdź, czy upstream działa i jest osiągalny, i przeczytaj log błędów serwera proxy (nginx, load balancera lub CDN).

The server cannot handle the request now.es: El servidor no puede atender la solicitud ahora, normalmente por sobrecarga o mantenimiento.
The server cannot handle the request now.pt-BR: O servidor não consegue tratar a requisição agora, geralmente por sobrecarga ou manutenção.
The server cannot handle the request now.fr: Le serveur ne peut pas traiter la requête pour le moment, généralement à cause d'une surcharge ou d'une maintenance.
The server cannot handle the request now.de: Der Server kann die Anfrage derzeit nicht bearbeiten, meist wegen Überlastung oder Wartung.
The server cannot handle the request now.id: Server tidak dapat menangani permintaan saat ini, biasanya karena kelebihan beban atau pemeliharaan.
The server cannot handle the request now.it: Il server non può gestire la richiesta in questo momento, di solito per sovraccarico o manutenzione.

Send Retry-After during maintenance. Sca.hi: मेंटेनेंस के दौरान Retry-After भेजें। ओवरलोड हो तो क्षमता बढ़ाएँ या लोड घटाएँ।
